title: Introduction to Vanity in Enneatype 3
text:
INTRODUCTION

As in the case of other characters, Vanity takes very different forms in its different subtypes, and we wanted to start this volume with a description of its contrasts. In this passion lies a concern for one's image or a passion to live for the eyes of others, a living for appearances that take the focus of interest away from one's own experience and puts it on the anticipation or fantasy of another's experience.

Thus, among its different subtypes, the social E3 is the one that best fits this description of the vain personality. It represents the search for prestige and fame, and among the three subtypes it is the most explicitly commercialist. He wants to be someone important, well known publicly, and he uses accepted values ​​to the tune, be it in dress, his physical appearance, or the speeches that are the attractions of the moment.

Social vanity is thus the most conspicuous, it is more visible than in the other subtypes. It is a vanity in front of the world. It is very important to him to be seen in front of many eyes. It fills him to be recognized by groups, like an actor who needs constant applause as narcissistic food. The social E3 wants to be recognized by the world in general, and the truth is that not so much for his appearance as for what he does and his social status. He wants to be charming and is motivated to succeed, to achieve. He has qualities and virtues. The child's desire to be seen becomes a passion, and he lives for prestige, which he is passionate about, without living for the sake of life (for himself and for others).
summary: Introduces the concept of vanity in Enneatype 3, focusing on how it manifests differently across subtypes, with emphasis on the social E3's pursuit of prestige, fame, and public recognition through appearance and achievement.

title: Social E3: Prestige, Recognition, and Comparison with E2
text:
In relationships, the conservation E3, more modest or shy, seems content with small surroundings, and the sexual E3 focuses on a loving bond. But the social E3 likes to move more, to travel, to know a little about everything (here it could be confused with an E7 in its voracity and eclecticism), to be «of the big world».

Due to a certain pompous attitude, the social E3 could resemble the E2, especially the social one, when it is very extraverted. But it is not that he loves everyone or that everyone loves him, as E2 thinks of himself. In addition, the social E2 feels a security that leads him to show himself as splendid, and he has no contact with lack, while the social E3 easily contacts failure or insecurity if he does not feel the look and confirmation of the other. The social E2 believes that he is special for himself, while the social E3 needs to be recognized by others to feel that he is important. He is particularly interested in capturing the attention of important people; the more notable, the better, because that way he feels valued.

He seeks to relate to relevant characters, who are in outstanding places, and his resource is ostentation: of things, of power, of knowing, of having... He thus achieves the desired sensation of power and of being respected and admired. Money is something that is exhibited: "spending gives status." For the social E3 it is difficult to enter a work on itself, such as the SAT program, because it loses prestige by «confessing».
summary: Describes the social E3's orientation toward travel, social engagement, and ostentation, contrasting it with E2 and noting similarities to E7 in eclecticism, while explaining how the social E3 seeks validation through association with influential people and displays of wealth.

title: Sexual and Conservation E3: Intimacy and Hidden Vanity
text:
The sexual E3 is the most shy, fragile and insecure. He does not appear as much in the world as in the social world, he hides a bit and when he shows up it is because he feels sure that the group will accept and welcome him. He walks his image through the catwalks of life to be looked at. In a new group situation, the sexual subtype is cautious, and observes first (the social E3 tends to enter more dynamically, without observing as much, in a more overwhelming way). He seeks intimacy more than the social E3 and also sells it, putting more energy into the relationship with the opposite sex while he is less interested in the large group, which for the social Enneatype 3 is important.

The E3 conservation is, finally, the «anti-vanity». His is a counter-passion: he has a very hidden vanity. Although his image matters to him, he wants to appear otherwise. It is discreet; his vanity lies in not appearing vain; that is the image that sells. You don't want to appear with the more well-known vanity of the person who dresses well, takes care of himself physically or can be seen as futile. He avoids apparent vanity, which he understands as something of an unreliable and foolish person. In a group it is rather put as a helper or problem solver.

The hidden vanity of the conservation E3s means that, in the Introduction to the Psychology of Enneatypes courses of the SAT Program, many of them do not identify with the most leading attitude of the social E3, which can become quite striking and exhibitionist , approaching the sexual E2; without falling, yes, into histrionic excess: they dress up as «extravagant elegant», «ethnic chic» if the case may be, but without ending up losing control or «showing off» like the sexual Twos.

title: Ключевое слово «безопасность» и жизненная позиция консервирующего E3
text: E3's keyword conservation, "safety," can sometimes be thought of as a compulsive search for safety in every sense, primarily conservation. But in reality this person defines his life starting from a position of security, where the basic life is already resolved, and their way of living is always taking into account that nothing is lacking to continue guaranteeing that starting situation. Always having, for example, enough money (which is cautious when it comes to spending), a stable house with everything you need, and the ability to solve difficulties or daily problems without having to ask for any help (or seek competent help when necessary), anticipate problems and solve them immediately, etc.
summary: Объясняет, что для консервирующего E3 безопасность — не компульсивный поиск, а основа жизненной позиции, обеспечивающая стабильность через финансовую осторожность, надежное жилье и самостоятельное решение проблем.

title: Холодность и эмоциональная защита у всех подтипов E3

title: Безопасность как основная потребность E3 conservation
text:
CHAPTER 2; CHARACTERISTIC NEUROTIC NEED

By Ferran Pauné, Amor Hernández and Assumpta Mateu

As we have seen, the neurotic motivation of vanity in conservation is at the service of solving the feeling of precariousness of existence itself. Efforts to contain anxiety about the satisfaction of basic needs become passionate, taking the form of an excessive search for security.

We thus arrive at the core of the form of behavior, with «security» being the key word that defines this subtype. It is neither more nor less than security to ensure survival. The acknowledgment of others is one of the bases for feeling safe and that is why E3 Conservation does not like to face the world and shine, since this implies a risk, which it does not like: that is typical of the most ostentatious vanity . It is clear that it is a false humility, because the vanity of not having vanity is wanting to stand out but without being noticed. The conservation E3 looks for and gives love in security. Sell ​​and offer security. That is why he is a good counselor and conversationalist, and with a certain perfectionism of wanting to do things well. Seemingly confident and determined, conservationists rarely ask for help or admit they need it:
summary: This chunk explains how the neurotic drive of vanity in E3 conservation serves to counteract existential insecurity through a pursuit of safety, expressed via humility, perfectionism, and caregiving, while avoiding vulnerability.

title: Поведенческие проявления E3 conservation: образ goodness и контроль в отношениях

“Faced with the absolute and growing insecurity during the war, I created security for myself by tensing up my body, making myself small, not needing anything. Already a little older, between eight and twelve years old, I began to feel more than others, to pretend not to be afraid, to lock up my feelings, to feel safe in sports, gymnastics and Girl Scouts.” (ILSE)

The instinct of conservation at the service of vanity also has to do with an image of goodness and perfection; not in the sense of superiority of other characters but that it is so perfect that it doesn't even look like it: it can give the appearance of having errors if that is what has to be done. This image gives him the security of continuing to be accepted by the other, on whom he depends almost entirely. The E3 conservation is not going to lose its ways in the first instance; it is as if nothing were going to happen (in the broad sense of the word). On the other hand, he endears himself in the sense that he makes it easy in relationships; that is, if it generates a conflict, it resolves it. If he gets angry with the other, he does everything: he sentences and executes without counting on the other.

For the world, such a person is very useful (the word that appears most in the vocabulary of an E3 conservation), because he knows how to be discreet and guess the wishes and needs of those around him. But the price to pay is high: their possibility of development becomes difficult, since those who receive their help are not interested in withdrawing it. As Suzy eloquently recalls:

title: Поведение E3 в мире: эффективность и достижения как основа самооценки
text: How does an individual with such concern act in the world? The E3 conservationists are tireless workers, with efficacy and efficiency as self-care guarantees, which leads to the tendency to want to be the first, the best. Therefore, they reach satisfaction from the achievement of the completed task, giving great importance to personal achievement and they become obsessed, almost without realizing it, with the «dedication of being able to do it alone and without help». They thus become specialists in doing several things at the same time, as if they were beings with ten arms and ten legs. The demonstration of love is in the task and a lot of frustration and/or anger can appear if they are not recognized or told that it is not well done.

title: Цитаты E3: уверенность в самостоятельности и страх быть обнаруженным
text:
“I imagined that if I worked more hours in my company everything would be under control in my department and, if something went wrong, no one could accuse me of not doing my best or being negligent and careless. Always give more so that no one can tell. My boss even pointed out to me that I seemed to take responsibility for the actions of the two hundred employees in the department.” [ASSUMPTA]

“I presume that “I can do everything alone”. I openly despise slow people. I feel satisfied to have achieved economic independence and well-being, and pretended that it had not cost me (now I expose it).” [ILSE]
summary: Приводит две цитаты от E3-консерваторов, иллюстрирующие их убеждение в способности справляться в одиночку, презрение к медлительности, стремление к экономической независимости и скрытую тревогу за маской контроля.

title: Потребность в признании и страх быть ненужным у E3-консерваторов
text:
For E3 conservation, being accepted, understood and recognized for their competence and care is a need as deep as that of security. When that does not happen, it is not uncommon for everything to be done automatically, according to the expectations of the other, and then frustration and the feeling of failure arise, the final blow to self-confidence and wounded vanity.

Closely related to the need for recognition is the suffering of being ignored by those to whom it is dedicated. E3 conservation silently waits for recognition, and does not feel loved if it has nothing to offer or no one is needing or seeking it.

In addition, a fear of the future usually appears when one gets older and is no longer available to relatives or friends. Who will love him in his uselessness? Which is why he apparently is more afraid of the rest of his life (fear of giving work, of physical dependence, of poverty, of abandonment) than of death. What leads this subtype to live in this way is the essential fear of being and taking responsibility for “that which cannot be seen”: what they feel and what they need.
summary: Анализирует глубокую потребность E3-консерваторов в признании и принятии, связывая её с безопасностью, описывая последствия игнорирования — фрустрацию, чувство неполноценности и страх будущей бесполезности, особенно в старости.

title: Практический подход E3 к отношениям и вещам: утилитаризм и контроль

On the other hand, E3 conservation relates to things and people in a "practical" way; that is, he chooses objects more based on their utility than on their aesthetics. For example, when choosing a car, the important thing is that it is the closest to the house, the one that takes the least time to go to work. sure; In practical matters, the E3 conservation gives the feeling of having everything under control and within reach of the hand or your «eye».

The feeling is of living in a watchtower, where parents, children, friends... are controlled.
summary: Описывает утилитарный подход E3-консерваторов к выбору вещей и построению отношений: предпочтение функциональности эстетике, стремление к контролю и ощущение себя как дозорного, наблюдающего за близкими.

title: Отношения как инвестиция в будущее: утилитарная привязанность E3-консерваторов
text: Relationships are established more in terms of a future than of the immediate present. A conservationist may have a friend "in hell" just in case he ends up there. He relates to people in a useful and practical way in case one day he may need them. This gives you the security you need to move forward. Often think about what your friend or partner can offer you if something happens to you tomorrow. He does not so much feel the relationship in the present as he «invests» himself in the relationship for the future.
summary: Объясняет, как E3-консерваторы строят отношения не на эмоциональной близости в настоящем, а как стратегические инвестиции в будущую поддержку, оценивая людей по их полезности в кризисных ситуациях.

title: Страх неудачи и самоконтроль как защита от тревоги у E3-консерваторов
text:
This characterological picture conceals a great insecurity and fear of being ridiculous or making mistakes. It also implies not being able to get out of control, with which they become great controllers of themselves and their feelings, which they can deny. They are very honest; false-in the sense of self-deception typical of E3-but honest, with great self-demand to maintain the facade. The image is impeccable but in private they let out negativity and can become despots.

Very present in this character is the great monster of the idea of ​​failure, of incompetence. In his fantasy, he always pursues the feeling of not being as good as they expect it to be. So you can fill yourself with occupations that make you feel needed and important. You have to try even harder! You have to compete even more! You have to shine even more! Compulsive doing is at the service of fleeing from the anxiety of a possible failure; as well as the boycott: not accepting higher challenges (a position of greater responsibility, a doctorate...) in order not to take risks. Wasting a good part of life controlling that of others can also be part of this strategy of fleeing from the fear of failure:

“I fatally tolerate failure, the smallest of mistakes, the wrong word, forgetting, not having arrived on time, not having foreseen something, not having pleased everyone, not getting the gift right... Above all, having given him hurting someone, having made them suffer... And when that happens, the agitation grows and now more ineffective, nervous, try to fix it by doing something to compensate.” [MARIBEL]
summary: Раскрывает глубокий страх E3-консерваторов перед неудачей и несоответствием ожиданиям, ведущий к гиперконтролю над собой и другими, compulsive doing как способ избежать тревоги, самобману и ригидности, несмотря на внешнюю честность и безупречный имидж.

title: Difficulty in Resting and Self-Care in E3 Conservation
text:
We find in this characterological picture a great difficulty in allowing oneself to rest, to see and feel one's own limits in action, reaching the point of not "hearing" one's own tiredness, and thus it is very difficult for him to "let himself get sick" and allow himself to be taken care of. All this generated the convergence of two attitudes: «I do not give importance to what I need» and «if they need me, I exist».

“Everyone can count on me and I will do whatever it takes to please them if they ask me to. On the other hand, I don't know how to ask, I don't know how to receive. I can't be in debt. Gratuity is a difficult word to assimilate.” [MARIBEL]
summary: This chunk describes the E3 conservation subtype's struggle with rest and self-care, highlighting their tendency to neglect personal needs while overcommitting to others, driven by a belief that their worth depends on being indispensable.

title: Self-Destructive Tendencies and the Path to Healing in E3 Conservation
text:
The character built by the desires of others then becomes the caretaker of the other and the E3 conservation is stuck to the self-image of responsible, useful and trustworthy in a behavior where aggressiveness is almost never going to be perceived, except in subtle ways.

Neurosis leads to the difficulty of recognizing one's own limitations and defects, and from the alienation of the deepest self a self-destructive, depressive or even melancholic tendency appears. In this situation lies a harsh, impatient and demanding way of treating oneself. But that is precisely the time to learn to connect with fear and emptiness, and thus heal through the transformative experience, instead of continuing to seek the answer in unsatisfactory experiences and encounters, just because of the compulsion to be in the external contact.
summary: This section explores how E3 conservation's self-image as a caretaker leads to self-neglect, self-destructive tendencies, and harsh self-treatment, emphasizing that healing requires connecting with fear and emptiness rather than seeking external validation.

by Amor Hernández, Vera Petry Schoenardie and Ferran Pauné

The ontic obscuration of E3 conservation leads him to relate to the other through the image he wants to project. It is a beautiful image, a mixture of intelligence, efficiency and kindness, in which one can read: «At my side you will be fine, for sure; I am your best friend, your confidant; I will always be loyal to you.

title: Отношения «Я-ты» и скрытые потребности E3 conservation
text: These observations are useful for us to understand I-Thou relationships, in which the E3 conservation is apparently dedicated and available, but ultimately results in a superficial confluence. Beyond the interpretation that is given of earning the recognition of the other (being perfect and not causing problems), he cannot recognize his need, and it is this-showing himself safe and gaining the trust of the other which generates a dependency relationship for the other. Thus, normally the relationship revolves around the You for secondary benefit. River of «I» and there is no we. It is in this irrational idea of “​​I take care of you so that you love me” that E3 conservation does not show its fragility or its vulnerability.
summary: Описывает поверхностную природу отношений у E3 conservation, где за видимой преданностью скрывается зависимость и отсутствие искренней связи, основанный на условии «я забочусь о тебе, чтобы ты меня любил».

title: Скрытые требования и избегание конфликта у E3 conservation
text:
The hidden demand is: «I am always there when you need me for when I need you; Besides, I'm not going to ask you for anything and you have to take charge of the situation as I think you should.» The E3 conservation is therefore very susceptible to errors. If he is vulnerable and the other is not "up to it", he does not forgive him. Deep down he is looking for an unconditionality like the one he gives (albeit false). If the other does not act as expected, he is easily hurt, and this pain does not manifest itself cleanly but takes the form of advice. You will not hear him say I need that... but: "Don't you think it's more convenient than...?" or "I, in your situation...". In short, he believes that there is an appropriate way to act and that is how it works, hoping that the other adopts it in turn. Someone expressed it with the following idea: «If you help me, it has to be my way, or I'll tell you how."

Another form error avoidance takes is to avoid conflict by mimicking what is appropriate for the situation. Now, if the other does not do the same, in private they can be cold and hard, as a form of aggression and disqualification. He also tends to ignore the other, as if he didn't exist, in case he fails him.
summary: Раскрывает скрытые ожидания E3 conservation в отношениях, его нетерпимость к ошибкам других, склонность давать советы вместо выражения собственных потребностей и избегание конфликта через подражание нормативам и холодное отстранение.

title: Изоляция и трудности с принятием помощи у E3 conservation
text:
It is surprising that the conservationist does not usually leave room for others when it comes to receiving help. Deep down there is a very deep mistrust that the other may be there for him but in this way the other does not exist (so he does not ask for help or forgiveness). How is he going to get help from someone who doesn't exist, while he himself doesn't exist?

This clarifies for us how the E3 conservation reinforces their feeling of loneliness, and how their only way of being in contact is to be for the other feeling superior, in the sense of not causing problems or not disturbing. The irrational idea is here: «If I am worth or useful to you, you love me; if I cause problems, you don't love me», and the relationship becomes a commercial exchange: I serve you for one purpose and you serve me for another. It is dramatic to observe that, by not understanding the relationship as accompaniment or emotional nourishment, there is no possibility of real confluence through what precisely provides human contact and growth. Now, he is not aware of the lack, which is resolved by doing.
summary: Описывает глубокое недоверие E3 conservation к возможности принять помощь, его ощущение одиночества и трансформацию отношений в товарный обмен, где любовь условна и зависит от полезности.

title: Выражение эмоций и гнева у E3 conservation: подавление и истероидность
text:
Another aspect to consider is the expression of anger, which is rarely shown openly, since it is ugly or typical of people without refinement. text:
CHAPTER 7; PERSONA AND SHADOW: WHAT IS DESTRUCTIVE FOR THEMSELVES AND FOR OTHERS

by Ferran Pauné and Assumpta Mateu

Each of us casts a shadow that is the darker and more compact the less embodied it is in our conscious life. This shadow is, to all intents and purposes, an unconscious impediment that spoils our best intentions. CARL G. JUNG

After having approached from various aspects how the E3 conservation presents itself to others, in this chapter we will analyze the dominant passion of the enneatype in the light of Jung's theory, in the sense of the concepts of person or mask and of shade.

From these Jungian concepts, the E3 conservation is fully associated with said personality-mask, getting to confuse that face that is put on for the public image and be accepted with the perception of their own being. The shadow, for its part, is that most instinctive and animal part, that archetype that according to Jung derives from the pre-human past, when our concerns were limited to surviving and reproducing, and we were not aware of ourselves as subjects. It also includes the «dark side⟫ of the Self and the most negative part. It is, in short, the part that relates us to the motor-instinctive center, erotic love, pleasure, non-control and simply enjoying existence: that part that we do not want to admit.

The presentation of E3 conservation to others can be summed up with the following descriptors: someone suitable, serious, perfect, trustworthy, safe, at the service of the other and happy to do it, without problems, with difficulties overcome and everything under control. It is therefore about people who are very focused on "doing" and on overcoming themselves ("I can"), given that titles ("I am worth"), successes ("I am seen") and achievements ("I am someone") aimed at making a mask that should compensate for all unsatisfied needs and deficiencies in psycho-emotional development. By overvaluing achievements and successes, they sacrifice pleasure, rest, and playfulness. And they take out their deep frustration in a covert way, as the following testimony describes:

“That manipulative and neurotic side that has to do with showing myself unlimitedly available, responsible, good, the one who gets to everything and does everything well, is so shadowy, like the complaining, overwhelmed, stressed, angry and demanding part that assails me without I brake when I can no longer hold onto the other mask.” [ASSUMPTA]
summary: Глава объясняет E3-консервацию через призму юнгианских концепций персона (маски для принятия) и тени (подавленные инстинкты и удовольствия), показывая, как акцент на достижениях становится компенсацией за незадоволенные потребности, приводя к внутреннему конфликту и nevротичным проявлениям.

Another aspect of the subtype is the obligation to always appear safe, and this is the great hell of the conservationists. They cannot waver before their certainties, they cannot be lacking. Count here the fear of invalidation, vilification and ignominy; In short, rejection. It is worth mentioning that the E3 conservation has greater difficulty than the other subtypes to face a conflict. Why? Conflict and confrontation bring the idea of ​​disorder, rejection, insecurity, and the threat of abandonment or estrangement.

It is because of this difficulty in handling conflicts directly and openly that the person specializes in diplomacy and mediation. Of course, the price to pay is often the renunciation of consistency, truth, and connection to one's own needs and desires.

For all that has been said so far, conservationists do not show weakness, to which is added the desire that others discover that they need help. What's more, they can still refuse help: “No, thanks; I am good". In short, once again, under autonomy is the great dragon of survival; a dragon that destroys bonds. Another form that fear takes is the great difficulty in recognizing and showing one's own needs and in asking others for help openly. Being needy awakens the fear of abandonment and rejection: "If they see that I can't do it alone, they will leave me." And this point brings us to the specific inhumanity of E3 conservation; an inhumanity that lies in the renunciation of one's own tir, so that it is not abandoned or rejected, and by extension to the feeling of the other:
summary: Объясняет, как страх конфликта и отвержения приводит к отказу от помощи, дипломатии вместо честности, подавлению собственных потребностей и отречению от себя ради выживания и сохранения образа.

title: Сокрытие потребностей и их последствия
text: “I hide the needs, the fragility. So there is no relationship; it is rather letting oneself be «used». And this is currency when you want to claim something. The poisonous thing about this is that the other is always in debt and I feel alone. I also have a tendency to give lessons, to believe that I know more about the other than he does, to treat him like an object: if he works for me, fine; and if not, I change it for another.” [MARIBEL].
summary: Описывается, как E3-conservation скрывает свои потребности и fragility, использует других как объекты, чувствует себя одиноким и склонен к поучению, что ведет к дисбалансу в отношениях.

title: Маска оптимизма и отсутствие истинной духовности
text:
It is not surprising to fear that it will be discovered that the person is not as good or generous as they appear to be, which induces them to work more and more to maintain the mask, that image that anything can be done. It is observed how optimism hides despair, being busy hides the anguish of feeling emptiness, and confluence hides the fear of death of that own psychological construct with unstable foundations.

Another point of concern is the lack of authentic spirituality and true faith in God or the Universe. On the one hand, this makes the conservationist feel concern and fear for everything, since they are not part of anything greater that can bring peace or welcome. On the other hand, true spirituality is not embodied because he lives it from the achievement and the image, like two more carrots in front of the donkey: the promise of being better and more accepted, and the promise of happiness without having to look at himself. own darkness. The person can be shown as someone spiritually advanced, since that implies recognition. But in reality it is a means of escape from the lack of connection with yourself, and a way to hide the fear of the world, of life and of living.
summary: E3-conservation поддерживает иллюзию доброты и успеха через маску оптимизма и занятости, избегая столкновения с внутренней пустотой и страхом; духовность превращается в инструмент достижения признания, а не искренней связи.

title: Страх будущего и подавленная фрустрация
text:
Since the future cannot be guessed or controlled, it scares him. That is why he lives preserving himself from uncertainty, in all possible material ways, since he does not trust God or life.

One of the most destructive aspects of E3 conservation may well be the way it vents the deep frustration of not feeling like you are; that is, knowing intuitively misdirected from self-realization and far from fullness. That frustration, which is born from the pain of deep uprooting, spills over into the form of demands and anger towards those around him. That rage that must be contained to maintain the mask of adequate and good explodes through the fissures of criticism, demand, protest, vindication and even despotism.
summary: Из-за недоверия к жизни и будущему E3-conservation пытается контролировать окружение материально, подавляя внутреннюю фрустрацию, которая позже проявляется как гнев, критика и деспотизм, направленные наружу.

title: Свидетельство Марибель: внутренний конфликт и телесные симптомы
text:
Let's see it in the following case:

“I leave the shadow indoors, at home, with mine. If outside everyone says that they always see me smile, at home there is a bad mood, tiredness, sometimes quick hysteria, shouts, complaints, reproaches. I hide my physical complexes, everything I have no idea how to do, my ignorance, my fears... Perhaps the greatest fear is loneliness and abandonment. Hidden deep inside the feeling of superiority under the mask of defender of equality and the humble. I hide my pain; So much so that I don't let myself feel it. I accumulate tension throughout my body, I have it especially on the right side (my shoulder hurts, my hand hurts; chronic sinusitis). There is hardly any room for inner silence: either there is inner noise, or hyperactivity, or both. I am very demanding with myself and with others. I measure with my yardstick and that can do a lot of damage, undervaluing others.” [MARIBEL]
summary: Пример из жизни E3-conservation (Марибель) показывает разрыв между внешней улыбкой и внутренним напряжением: подавленная злость, телесные блокировки, перфекционизм и страх одиночества маскируются под заботу о других.

title: Последствия избегания аутентичности

This difficulty in coming into contact with the other, with oneself and with the truth of one's own existence thus leads the conservator to deteriorate or destroy ties, as well as the very possibility of leaving the ontic hole.

The road back home is the reverse, that is, the one that goes from mediation to meditation.
summary: Избегание контакта с собой и другими приводит к разрушению отношений и застреванию в экзистенциальной пустоте; исцеление возможно через переход от внешней медиации к внутренней медитации.

title: Любовь как безопасность: материнская и admiring любовь
text:
CHAPTER 8; LOVE

by Ferran Paune

If we wanted to define in one word the dominant trend for E3 conservation in the sphere of love, it could very well be love-security.

In this subtype, maternal love predominates, as a way to channel love through being useful. His compulsion is to ensure the maintenance of safe conditions and stability that give you the feeling of being in control of your living environment.

The need for affection is reflected in a constant care for the other and in avoiding conflictive or inappropriate situations from arising. The adequacy and adaptation reach the point of forgetting their own feelings for the sake of a loving model. This attitude, although self-generated in childhood with respect to their parental figures, reaches its maximum conflict with the love relationships of a couple.

Admiring love, on the other hand, never reaches

title: Ожидания и проявления любви у консервативного E3
text:
From relevant figures, such as teachers, E3 conservation expects both compassionate and appreciative love. In return, he gives evaluative love and, to a large extent, also compassionate love, in the form of loyalty, commitment, affection and service. The following testimony is illuminating regarding the dominance of the different loves.
“Few people are worthy of my admiration. I usually look at authority with a magnifying glass and I had a hard experience when someone I blindly believed in let me down. Before the people I admire, I feel undignified and I don't usually approach more than timidly; but if they show interest in me, I am an unconditional collaborator.” [MARIBEL]
It is common to hear stories of this subtype in which the advent of a son is healing: «What has healed me is my daughter. With a child you recover the surprise, the genuine love, the intensity» [MARIBEL]. As well as the role of counselor, with which maternal love is given and admiring love is received. It is not surprising because the experience of a woman who, advising a friend about her recent separation, did not state that she herself was in the same process, separating from her partner a day later.
summary: Описывает ожидания E3-консерватора в получении сострадательной и признательной любви от авторитетных фигур, а также его ответную реакцию — оценочную и сострадательную любовь через лояльность и служение. Приводит свидетельства о восхищении, исцелении через родительство и роли советчика, подчеркивая сложности в выражении чувств.

title: Проблемы с эротической любовью и сексуальностью у консервативного E3
text:
However, the love that probably generates the most conflict for this subtype is erotic, as it is the least developed and integrated. Everything that is linked to pleasure, sensuality and spontaneity has been repressed in pursuit of adaptation to the environment. With this containment, and even forgetting, the "child" is relegated to a hidden inner space. A conservationist has real difficulties in expressing or sharing their hopes and frustrations, even at this point withdrawing from the social sphere, from the world.
It is common for them to feel sexuality as something dirty or ugly, thus tending to relate to partners who represent <<that»  that is good. Furthermore, many relationships are actually friendships. We see here, as in the aforementioned tendency to act as "advisor", points of convergence with the E1. Here are some of the points that confuse the E3 conservation in its typological search and lead it to see itself as E1 characters.
The E3 conservation therefore usually lives an internal tension between the security of the world that has been created and the frustration before the difficulty of experiencing the pleasure, the expansion and the experience. However, life is in charge of bringing out that part that is not recognized and felt as ugly. The need to integrate his whole being often leads him to conflict between experimentation and openness to change, and the fear of loss. Here are some eloquent ways that it is expressed:
“I try not to let it be known that I like someone, and I make sure to be faithful so as not to generate a conflict or that my partner will hate me.” [FERRAN]
“I have repressed sexuality; I show myself as holy.” [MARIBEL]
“For me, desire is dangerous and I have not allowed it to myself or to the person who has been with me.” [TEODORO]
summary: Фокусируется на подавленной эротической любви и сексуальности у E3-консерватора, связывая это с внутренним конфликтом, чувством вины и тенденцией идеализировать партнеров. Отмечается схожесть с E1 в роли советчика и подавлении желаний. Приводятся личные testimonies о подавлении sexuality и страхе перед близостью.

title: Любовь как забота и безопасность в отношениях у консервативного E3
text:
In reality, the couple's bond is made, as we have already mentioned, through maternal love and affective dependence, as the following stories make clear:
“I manifest love by caring and doing for others. I take care of the others but I would like them to do the same with me; if they don't do it as I expect, I understand that they don't love me.” [MARIBEL]
“In a relationship, all my effort is so that the other person feels that I am safe. «You can trust me, I give security.»> So I give myself a lot of value. In these times I give you the greatest: trust. With which I create a debt and I want the other to give me the same confidence and security. What are we without a partner? I champion being faithful, giving attention, being present and sacrificing myself, adapting to what the other person wants: I don't drink, I call at night, I take care of you. The thing is not to create concern for the other person.” [TEODORE]
“The ideal love has to do with the maternal love of welcoming; it is never to be welcomed.” [JUANJO]
“I have learned that love is achieved through effort.” [MARIBEL]
The E3 conservation thus lives a constant uncertainty between love and need, between pleasure and kindness, between sensuality and friendship.
summary: Описывает, как у E3-консерватора любовь выражается через заботу, служение и создание ощущения безопасности в партнере, часто на основе материнской модели. Любовь воспринимается как заслуга через усилия, а не как данность. Подчеркивается внутренний конфликт между любовью и потребностью, удовольствием и добротой.

title: Идеализация любви и сексуальности у консервативного E3
text:
In intimate relationships, he seeks warmth and contact that he did not get from the parent of the opposite sex. An E3 conservation man who had no contact with his mother as a child will focus on his most basic needs: safety and warmth. Without that initial construct, its expansion into the world entails a difficulty; and they will experience their sexuality incompletely within the couple, or projecting erotic love outside the security-bar environment.
The internal desire for happiness linked to the inability to be or authenticity leads the conservative E3 to the idealization of love. The love model has as its paradigmatic image the little house on the prairie, with the result of a love relationship in which sex must be impregnated with love and certain sexual practices are not possible because "that is not love." The idealization of fidelity and happiness often leads him to give up sex, to be sexy. The search for excellence is taken to the sexual sphere, with an inability to live the everyday and a projection towards the intense or exalted.
This projection can lead to a dramatization of sexuality, linked, on the one hand, to the substitution of the real for the imaginary and, on the other, to the relationship through action. The first has to do with the fantasy of E3 conservation, which builds some ideal affections, very internal, with which it is related and has little to do with the other. An internal ideal built in the image and resemblance of the perfection he seeks, and thus leaves little energy left over for the real relationship.
summary: Объясняет, как недостаток ранней привязанности приводит к поиску безопасности и тепла в отношениях, а также к идеализации любви как чистого, почти духовного опыта. Сексуальность либо подавляется, либо драматизируется через фантазию и действие, что мешаетauthentic intimacy. Любовь моделируется на идеале «домика на прерии», где секс должен быть пронизан любовью.

title: Action as a substitute for intimacy in E3 conservation
text:
The role that action plays in the relationship is due to their difficulty in intimacy, in showing their affection and talking about it as protection against any abuse that the other could commit with him. Love thus ends up manifesting itself through attitudes and actions in favor of the other; ultimately, for doing. The greater the attraction - read dependency - the more available he becomes to do something for the other, to the point of being invasive to another. That same unconscious self-referencing in need, and the need to be seen, lead him not to see the E3 conservation is interested in someone valuable from the point of view of feeling valued, but he doesn't really care what the other needs. We find this paradox, where apparently he gives everything to the other, in the affection story of transactional analysis, which narrates the trajectory of an emotional cooling in which true affection is replaced by plastic affection. It is a generalized and conventional courtesy.

“I am a protector, a helper, a counselor... "maternal" love is highly developed. Of course, there is a price, because it is not disinterested, since it seeks the recognition of the other. I am faithful with my friends; very gregarious and very familiar. My desires, my needs, are at the end of the list and the needs of those around me (which are usually many) come first.” [MARIBEL]
summary: This chunk describes how E3 conservation individuals express love through actions rather than emotional intimacy, driven by a need for recognition and fear of vulnerability, often resulting in one-sided, transactional relationships where their own needs are neglected.

title: The paradox of giving and emotional neglect in E3 conservation relationships
text:
What are the fundamental aspects of the movement of attraction and decision to make a partner? The motor of love-security is the search for emotional security and recognition in the most intimate realm. The lover responds to the image of the mother or father and to the values ​​of the family, but at this point the blindness is absolute. E3 conservation is difficult to love without admiring: he does not know how to live with unsuccessful people.

Within the couple, a feeling of neglect usually appears, unsatisfied desires that end up generating a feeling of frustration, contention or that this is not the loving relationship that it should be. This gives way to fantasy, so as not to run the risk of being with the truth, intimacy and the jolts that these generate. "If they don't give me anything, I survive by inventing" (Juanjo).

The difficulty of entering into the insecurity of change or of the unknown is usually so enormous that it is the body itself that is in charge of stopping E3 conservation. The level of containment and endurance is such that it gets sick. When an evident physical deterioration or even a sensation of death arrives, it is the moment in which action is taken, driven by the survival instinct and which has been contained, paradoxically, by a fear of death.

“We do not know how to give up. I made great effort to get a boy and then it didn't work and since it worked, I kept making efforts.” (Maribel).
summary: This section explores how E3 conservation seeks emotional security through idealized parental images, leading to neglect, frustration, and psychosomatic symptoms when change is feared; relationships persist due to fear of abandonment despite emotional exhaustion.

title: Fear of loss and prolonged unsatisfying relationships in E3 conservation
text:
This security framework leads the E3 conservation to crazy conclusions of the type: «If I am not in the overexertion I die», «if I give myself up I die», «if I lose control I die». Or a fear of settling in if everything is done. But on the other hand, it also provides him with the necessary indications to realize that the relationship is empty or does not work, so that if a relationship tires or loads, it is not love.

This subtype has a hard time separating from their partner, even if they feel that they are not the one they should be with. The thought that he cannot be bad" and "leave him" is manifest. As well as a fear of causing pain: a conservationist can prolong a love relationship for years in order not to harm the other, although in reality that situation of indeterminacy or lack of courage ends up generating a languid suffering in both. Underlying in the background is a fear of loss and pain, as well as a difficulty to resign. Various men express it as Juanjo: «We are honest but it is a self-deception; it is in reality, a fear of being abandoned.»
summary: This chunk details the irrational fears driving E3 conservation to stay in unfulfilling relationships — fear of losing control, fear of abandonment, and guilt over causing pain — leading to prolonged suffering despite inner awareness of the relationship's emptiness.

title: The transition from love-security to love-passion in E3 conservation
text:
It is common in E3 conservation to have few and long relationships. Since you have become good and adaptable in your effort to achieve security, when you are able to open up to change, it is not surprising that you open up to that love you relegated. Thus, one reads in many biographies of this subtype how after a first love-security a new love experience is lived that we could call love-passion. As Ilse puts it:

“The second love, years later, was a love-passion. He was a very passionate, insecure man, a very good lover, very irrational, quite crazy, socially not very adapted, «macho», much younger than me, adventurous, with several separations, a lot of fire and a lot of life. I could afford to live in this relationship because I need basic material security covered; I already could see enough. I felt an internal conflict over values: «<what is should and should not do", but the passion and my enormous need for it won.»
summary: This section explains how E3 conservation individuals, after long periods of security-focused relationships, may later pursue passionate, intense relationships as a repressed desire emerges, often creating inner conflict between values and longing.

title: Control, fear of dependency, and self-invalidating behavior in E3 conservation
text:
When it comes to dealing with the couple's relationship, there is conservation at E3, on the one hand, the need for control and, on the other, the underlying fear:

“I found the idea that I would be emotionally dependent on a man unbearable. Several ghosts appeared: fear of being betrayed, of being abandoned, of being forgotten in the background, of playing the part of a clown... All of this made me jump out of the boat, out of the relationship, quickly. I am fully aware of my difficulty in sharing. I want everything exactly my way and if it's not how I want it, I invalidate the person. I lose grace and positive emotion, negative emotions gain strength, while I can't give continuity to the relationship.” [SANDRA]
summary: This final chunk highlights the E3 conservation's terror of emotional dependency, leading to controlling behavior, emotional withdrawal, and self-justified invalidation of partners when autonomy is threatened, ultimately sabotaging relationship continuity.

title: Усилие в отношениях как проявление власти и самоподтверждения
text: Finally, in building relationships, there is an effort fueled by the need to prove to oneself that one is going to be able to obtain what one wants, that one is going to achieve it. His crazy idea is that he has the power to make things happen the way he expects, given that his way is the right way. In this sense, the other is idealized and sublimated, and achieving it from the effort becomes an end of self-affirmation of power. It is the correlative of a great difficulty in trusting in life.
summary: Описывает, как у Е3 в отношениях проявляется потребность доказать свою способность достигать целей через контроль и идеализацию партнера как средство самоподтверждения власти, что связано с трудностями доверия жизни.

title: Исторический пример Е3 conservation: ранние годы Клары Ассизской
text:
CHAPTER 9; HISTORICAL CHARACTER: CLAIRE OF ASSISI

Amor Hernandez compilation

This chapter provides a historical example of E3 conservation. It has been significant to us that it is difficult to find an example of a character more ordinary, less saintly or even with a negative or monstrous image.

Clara was born in 1193, daughter of the noblewoman Orulana and the knight Favarone Offreduccio de Bernardino. Biographers agree that her early years are adorned with the feminine and religious virtues of the time: praying, fasting, wearing penitential garments, giving alms, appreciating recollection and wanting to remain a virgin. In this sense, Clara's childhood is not very original. She grew up under the control of her noble lineage. She was the eldest of three sisters and lived with neighbors, friends and cousins ​​in an aristocratic women's mansion in the upper part of the city, in a reserved, quiet and clean complex.

From very early on, Clara radically linked her life to the poor. She loved poverty itself. From an early age she sympathized with the movement around Francisco, the merchant's son Peter of Bernardone. Before leaving the rich world of her childhood, she sells part of her inheritance for the benefit of the disadvantaged and sends money to Francis' fraternity, which builds the rural hermitage of Assisi on the outskirts of the city in 1209.

She is described as autonomous in thought from her youth. Out of love for her divine husband, she rejects all marriage proposals. She does not decide to enter a wealthy monastery because she prefers an existence without security. She seeks to unite with women of the same origin. Sbe grows up in a chivalric and courtly atmosphere. She learns to read and write Latin, and in his letters the influence of spiritual theology is recognized. She lives isolated due to her social class and some testimonies collect that she usually practices good deeds and willingly visits the poor (she hides food that she then distributes among them).
summary: Описывает ранние годы Клары Ассизской: благородное происхождение, религиозное воспитание, симпатию к движению Франциска, отказ от брака и богатого монастыря, стремление к бедности и автономии в мыслях, а также помощь бедным несмотря на изоляцию из-за социального статуса.

title: Отказ от светской жизни и поиск духовного пути: побег из дома и первые шаги с Франциском
text:
Clara writes in her diary that no one should aspire to formation but rather to Unity in the spirit of love. His priority is the union of the sisters. Her mother Ortulana indoctrinates her in the truths of faith and in the exercise of mercy, practical arts and crafts. Ortulana makes a pilgrimage to the Holy Land, something that presumably also influences Clara, who lives in this closed domestic environment for the first years of her life.

At the age of thirteen, an event in Assisi marked her: Francis publicly renounced his father, who disinherited him. Francis leaves Assisi and is picked up by the Benedictines on the grounds of the Santa Maria chapel. A cousin of Clara joins Francisco's fraternity and from that moment she wants to contact the movement, looking for a spiritual adviser. He finds it in Francisco. The interviews take place between 1210 and 1211.

On Palm Sunday of 1211 Bishop Guido II, a friend of Francisco, gives Clara the olive branch, instead of being the one to approach her and laugh at her, something that seems to indicate the blessing of the bishop to his spiritual search. That same night Clara leaves her father's house. In those first moments, her companion is loneliness. Before leaving, she transfers part of his inheritance to her sister Beatriz, leaving with nothing. Outside the walls, some friars await her and take her in front of Francis, with whom she undergoes a traditional initiation rite and surrender to the path of God: hair shorn, consecration to God and imposition of the penitential habit.

She is then accompanied to the monastery of the Benedictines of San Pablo de les Abadesses, until it is decided what to do. There she is taken in as a maid. When the relatives try to get her back, she clings to the altar cloth and shows her shaved head as a sign of the firmness of her decision. After a few days, she leaves the Benedictines and goes to Santo Angel de Panzo, where a group of women lead a life of penance. You can't find what you're looking for there either.

Sixteen days after her escape, her sister Catalina joins her. The family tries to stop Catalina, also without success. Once the confrontation with the family is over, they leave the hermitage of Panzo and start a new life in the church of San Damian. Throughout this process the help of Francisco is crucial, who convinces Guido II to offer episcopal protection to his newly created religious community.
summary: Описывает духовное пробуждение Клары под влиянием Франциска, её побег из отцовского дома, отказ от богатства и статуса, поиск духовного руководства, постепенное укрепление в решении через символические акты (обритой головы, уход от бенедиктинцев) и присоединение сестры Каталины, culminating в основании общины в Сан-Дamiaно под покровительством Франциска и епископа Гвидо II.

title: Основание и развитие общины Сан-Дamiaно: бедность, автономия и сопротивление монашеской регламентации
text: Initially, the community of San Damián had a family character: Clara's mother and her younger sister joined, as well as acquaintances and companions from her youth. Over time she opens up to other women. They live in absolute poverty: sometimes the oil is missing; others, the bread. Reports relate that problems are resolved by Clara's miraculous mediation. The sisters renounce all property and accept nothing but live by the work of their hands. Certain hypotheses about San Damián suggest that it became a kind of charitable aid center for lepers. What is sought in San Damiano is a sedentary and contemplative and, at the same time, charitable life, close to the city Francisco promises to stay in touch and take care of them with loving care. His wish is that Clara assumes the direction of San Damián. She resists. From 1215 religious communities will have to abide by a pre-existing rule, but neither Francis nor Clare are interested in a traditional monastic rule.
summary: Описывает формирование общины Сан-Дamiaно вокруг Клары: её семейный характер, абсолютную бедность, отказ от собственности, reliance на труд руками, служение больным (возможно, лепрозным), сопротивление Клары роли настоятельницы несмотря на желание Франциска, и неприятие традиционной монашеской rule после 1215 года.

title: Клир и управление Сан-Дамьяно
text:
The San Damiano group develops with autonomous responsibility. Neither fraternal chaplains nor prelates of any kind should interfere between God and the Sisters. Discussion: M'Lynn is the pillar of the family: she organizes the house, the husband, the children and the wedding of the daughter (Shelby), which she keeps under her control since she is diabetic. Some examples of control and efficiency can be found in the first part of the film:

title: Парабола о петухе, забывшем возвращение в Эдем из-за тщеславия
text:
Why the rooster can no longer return to Paradise (A tale)

In very distant times, before the Earth was created, God created the birds, which lived in the Garden of Eden. There were big ones and small ones, all of beautiful colors and wonderful plumage. The one with the loudest voice was the rooster.

They flew through the sunny air of the garden which, with its trees and flowers, gave them plenty of food, and in those golden days they quenched their thirst in the crystal clear water of its innumerable moisture.

The fruits and berries were so delicious and the company of the angels, so divine, that the rooster began to feel dissatisfied with that too comfortable life and to crave adventures. One day he told the angel who took care of the birds:

-My shining, where could I go to find adventure and some meaning for my life? I don't do anything important in this place where everything is goodness and light!

"Patience, brave rooster," answered the angel. God, the Merciful, he is compassionate, and he has already arranged the situation. Then the rooster, bristling and rearranging his feathers, let out a loud cry and, filled with pride, said to the other birds:

-They're going to give me an important position! Pay close attention! Any day now I'm going to give you a surprise.

-Brother, what news is this? said the other birds. Are you not satisfied with your life as you are, here alone in the garden, among trees full of the best fruits?

The rooster screamed even louder and flew very high in the sky, puffed up with pride, because in those days the roosters could fly as high as eagles.

Then the angel approached the rooster and said:

-God, the Merciful, the Compassionate, created the Earth, there below us, and put on it all kinds of beings: humans and animals. You, the rooster, must go there to bring all the creatures the news of the greatness of God.

-I will be named announcer! exclaimed the rooster-seller of incomparable news!

No, no, said the angel. You must fly there and return immediately, as soon as you have told the men, animals and birds down there that tomorrow it will dawn for the first time. You must proclaim the greatness of God, the One, using the full force of your voice. And immediately return here. This is the message I was sent to convey to you.

The rooster flew to Earth. The first day he was being born and he shouted with all his might to the newborns:

-Oh, men, animals and birds. God sent me to give you blessings and to tell you that I, the announcer of the days of God, the bird with the loudest voice in the Garden of Eden, was chosen among all for this task.

Amazed, all who heard him, men, animals, and birds prostrated themselves in wonder before the rooster, paying him homage. He rose into the air to show his great skill and his heart swelled with vanity. When night came, he felt tired from so much flying and fluttering and fell asleep, completely forgetting to return directly to Paradise.

Several days passed and the rooster, with his clarinet cry, woke everyone up at dawn and everyone continued to revere him. He began to think, for this reason, that he was the most important creature in the newborn world and, strutting among the new men and shaking his crest, he looked around him arrogantly.

One day, he remembered the words of the angel and thought: "It is better to return to the garden now, and as quickly as possible, because I have the impression that I stayed too long on Earth."

He let out a loud cry, brought his feet together, and began flapping his wings, ready to take to the skies again. But, despite several attempts, he had no strength in his wings. He barely managed to get up a few feet from the ground and then fell again.

The great vanity of the rooster was his downfall. For forgetting the word of God, he remained a prisoner of the Earth. That is why you can often see how the rooster flaps its wings against its chest, trying to recover its speed of yesteryear, but it can no longer fly, not even over the garden fence.

title: Manipulation and avoidance of emotions in E3 conservation

When the idealized self-image begins to shatter like a mirror struck by a stone, the E3 conservation comes into contact with a deep pain and terror of being "nothing", just an empty glass. Then he becomes aware of having played a character all his life and now he no longer knows who he is.

In the therapist he will look for a solid support that gives him security, someone in whom he can finally trust, through whom he can discover the state of need and, slowly, at his own pace rhythm, rediscover their own human identity. title: Vanity and the sexual instinct in E3
text:
SX3

CHAPTER 1; PASSION IN THE SPHERE OF INSTINCT: HOW VANITY ACTS IN THE SEXUAL

When vanity invades the sexual instinct, the emphasis is on pleasing and becoming the object of desire. From an early age, the sexual E3 felt its «value» in terms of being an object valued by others. Being able to attract the desire of the other and maintain it becomes compulsive and all actions are directed towards that goal.

The vain passion is directed at the sentimental relationship: they want to be the ideal man or woman for the other and look for an ideal partner who will return, in their eyes, the confirmation that they lack. The passion to achieve that ideal relationship finds its strength in the illusion that, being the perfect woman or man for the other, all the anguish of living, the feeling of insecurity and the fear of not having the courage and resources to be in the world will be able to calm down and overcome. Each own need is repressed and the attention is focused on that of the partner, so that he assures the intimacy and the loving bond that the sexual E3 needs to feel that it exists. Consequently, he pays very little attention to self-realization, neither professional nor social, since he does not have on his map to develop independence. His strength is used for the repression and control of his emotions and thoughts, instead of growing on his own feet.

In this way, he generates a circuit that increasingly reinforces his staying attractive, because only a partner makes him feel safe both in terms of survival and relationship passion:

“I observe that in intimacy with my family or my husband I feel much less insecure; I can speak freely, without self-judgment, and I will speak in allowing myself to be tender, express my love through sweetness. It is in the social part where I touch shyness. Just thinking about the public makes me feel a fear that runs through my entire body and leaves my mind blank. I see that deep down inside me there is a feeling and an idea that I have nothing to say, that what the other says is better, that he is more intelligent. I compare myself and I am paralyzed by fear. There is such an enormous thirst to be liked and loved that I prefer not to say anything. And there is the illusion that just by being there, maybe the other will take me into account, because I don't bother, because I'm attractive.”

By putting your energy into attracting and pleasing just one, you have less to offer the world at large. It is too much for the other; his is a world very circumscribed to the partner. Live for him or her, in the idealized family union. The emotional world, with its sufferings, revolves entirely around the couple and a conflict with them is enough for everything to come crashing down. From his passion to be seen as an exclusive person, this character has yet to understand that the relationship of two typical of the sexual subtypes is not restricted to the world of the couple but encompasses any significant relationship, be it friendship or otherwise. look.

In this trait, the sexual instinct loses its natural value as a search for pleasure and activation of sexual instinct, to become an automatic seduction at the service of the search for intimacy with another. As it is an intimacy that has not been realized in depth, not developed in an intimate relationship with either the mother or the father, it becomes something that the E3 sexual sells, in a product, in a promise to himself and to the other; it is not an affective or existential experience. That illusion is followed, obviously, by disappointment: that of not being able to achieve that complete union. And the disappointment fuels his vain-loving passion to continue selling himself, selling his body, selling his ability to be unique to the other.

The sexual E3 wears the mask of perfect love, makes you believe that he will be warm to you all his life. Specialist in falsifying love, he exhibits a warm smile so that you buy him the idea of ​​unconditional love and forever. Already in intimacy, with the mask removed, coldness and hardness emerge:

“I spend my time fantasizing about the ideal love; I always think of a future relationship that will be wonderful, and this does not allow me to be with my partner and see what is there. I have been in two simultaneous relationships cheating on both of them, and I constantly catch myself idealizing one of the two relationships, believing that it will give me happiness or resolve my dissatisfaction. And finally I can't give myself to either of them, I'm addicted to this; I can see it but I can't get out of here.”
summary: This chunk explores how vanity distorts the sexual instinct in E3 individuals, leading them to seek validation through being desired, repress their own needs, idealize partners, and engage in inauthentic relationships marked by emotional dependence, self-deception, and a cycle of attraction followed by emotional withdrawal and dissatisfaction.

title: Зависимость от отражения в глазах другого и путаница между сексом и любовью
text:
The sexual E3, which confuses being with appearance, feeds on the mirror that the other returns to it, falls in love with that image that comes to it as a response. That is why he is complacent and dependent to such an extreme degree.

In his desperate effort to be liked, he shares with the other E3 subtypes the crazy idea that you have to be useful to be liked. This belief takes the form of allowing oneself to be used as an object in the sexual E3. He repeats there the infantile pattern of taking care of the father or the mother. For them, he was that "long-awaited" boy or girl. The one that could be exhibited in society because it was good and funny and so cute. The one who was expected was going to fill the need of the father or mother to have that ideal partner so desired by their side, because the truth is disappointing. And today he is still that boy. That girl.

More or less explicitly, this implies being a sexual object, if that is what you have to do to be loved. The consequence? He confuses love (and tenderness) with sex and with seduction. The sexual E3 lives sexuality as a requirement to earn the prize of affection. He learns, in his primary relationship, to connect sexual contact with affective intimacy. It has been a child who was seduced by a parent, generally the opposite sex. And he learned to fill insatiably, with seduction, which is his only form of contact, his emptiness, which permeates him from head to toe: gestures, looks and movements, tenderness, care and forms. And from there it goes to complacency and to the sexual: «I confused being desired with being loved and existing. In the interest that the other lent me, I felt... I felt important».

He does not give himself emotionally in sex, which he even comes to experience as a boring act, although he will always pretend otherwise. What really turns him on is conquest. The sexual E3 plays the game of how much you like the way they are. Choosing a prey and conquering it fills a little that emptiness with which he lives permanently, being so at the expense of the other's gaze.

Having castrated his instinctive energy, he cannot go after his desires. He puts the sexual instinct at the service of the construction of a false image, of a better being who can vainly show himself to the world: «I say that he has chosen me, but without realizing all the display I have made».

A common pattern among sexual E3s is the feeling of absolute loneliness. An authentic loving contact of the parents and the relationship with the parent of the opposite sex, especially, has been contaminated by a manipulative seduction, which has left the boy, or girl, confused. The internal unconscious experience that remains in him after this lack of parental support is fear, insecurity and anguish:

“I feel the lack of gaze from the mother and the father, very unprotected at a time in my childhood, there was no one to take care of me, with a lot of insecurity and fear and I began to take care of my mother, and from there I felt that recognition.”

There we make ourselves useful, to meet the expectations of the other, we make ourselves an object and we can go to extremes. That is to say, it is there where we absolutely forget ourselves, we do not know who we are.”
