This confirms what many sexual E3 obsessively think: “If I appear to be desirable, inside and out, I will finally be loved by my partner, by whom I felt rejected the most.” This is how he confuses appearance with being.

The sexual E3 are seekers of love and their tragedy is not understanding that they cannot find it on the outside, through their appearance, to like it. They confuse the surface with the center. They lost confidence in their center, they lost contact with their existence, and they absolutely believe that they are the surface. His self- deception is to believe that if you look at its surface you are looking at its center.
summary: Despite their potential for genuine compassion and loving-kindness in their higher self, sexual E3s fall into the delusion that external appearance and being liked by a partner can restore love and worth. They confuse surface presentation with inner being, believing that enhanced attractiveness will rekindle love, tragically mistaking performance for authenticity and losing touch with their true essence.

title: Нарциссическая потребность в уникальности и пример Мэрилин Монро
text: Norman Mailer describes, in his famous biography of Marilyn Monroe, the art-to-please phenomenon of sexual E3. The secret of her success with men lay in her ability to make anyone feel that only he was capable of bringing out what was heard of her. The obsession with verifying that his impact on her is compulsive and has its origin in the loss of value. The narcissistic need here is to be unique for someone, or as if it were possible to sustain the pain of feeling, deeply and hiddenly, little.
summary: Using Marilyn Monroe as an example, the text illustrates the sexual E3's 'art-to-please' tendency: making each person feel uniquely special to gain validation. This behavior stems from a deep sense of worthlessness and a narcissistic need to be irreplaceable to someone, revealing how the E3 compensates for inner emptiness through performative intimacy.

title: Social E3: Passion for Image and Social Recognition
text: As a representative of this enneatype, the Social E3 is driven by a passion to offer an image In E3 Social, the vain egoic passion is not so much aimed at ensuring survival, or guaranteeing it for his family, as in the case of E3 Conservation. Nor to the security of having a partner who delights in him, who can guarantee him the experience of being loved. Instead, he puts his energy into satisfying the demand to be an “important” person. If he achieves social recognition, his fulfilment and existence are assured.
summary: This chunk describes how the Social E3 subtype is motivated by the need to project an image of importance to gain social recognition, which they equate with fulfillment and existence, unlike other subtypes focused on survival or intimate bonds.

title: Childhood Origins of Social E3: Lack of Authentic Reflection
text: Primary Primary relationships, especially with the father and perhaps with siblings, have not fulfilled in childhood the function of introducing the child to the social world with the security he needs to feel that he can enter the world with his resources, his talents, and his limits. The child has not had the experience of being deeply reflected in his value as a person, but only because of his successful results. The social instinct loses its nature of trust in an interpersonal bond that allows the deep experience of belonging and the recognition of being part of the context. The Social E3 compensates for this lack and the consequent feelings of worthlessness and powerlessness by creating an accepted, popular, functional self-image to the group, be it family or social. He transforms himself according to the needs of the group, believing that this imitative transmutation will transform him and recognize him as a member...
summary: This chunk explains that the Social E3 develops from childhood experiences where relationships failed to reflect the child’s intrinsic worth, leading to a reliance on performance and external validation to feel belonging and value.

title: Social E3: External Validation as Substitute for Belonging
text:
The authentic need to be supported and recognized, first in the family and then relationally in a broader sense, turns into a need to have money or to be admired as a special person, in the illusion that success is only possible capable of giving him back the place he never felt as his own: a security of belonging that guarantees his existence as a person.

Specifically, he settles into a compulsive passion for bonding and networking, as if the number of acquaintances, especially important people, could compensate for the lack of that emotional and affective depth that any interpersonal bond of love and esteem implies. Vanity as a basic passion motivation manifests itself in the social subtype as the need to sell and display a high-profile public image (social vanity), imagining that a social status can replace an existential experience that is lacking.
summary: This chunk describes how the Social E3 substitutes the deep need for belonging with external markers of success like wealth, admiration, and social status, using networking and image management as compensation for emotional absence.

title: Social E3: Image as Identity and Loss of Inner Connection
text:
Social E3 actively seeks achievement, money, and success, which are aimed at gaining and consolidating status. Consciousness is stuck in the external, in the form. The image is what will give identity: “I’m what others see”.

By identifying with the external object that is linked to the social value of prestige, of brilliance, the Social E3 identifies with different roles, wearing different masks, but in this way remains in a void, with no connection to the internal. The person cannot touch his roots, reach the depths of his being, or rest, because he does not trust his feelings and perceptions.

The image is sculpted through actions that aim to perfect it. Each context requires a different presence, and the Social E3 adapts to what is appropriate in each situation. This is why it is considered the most “chameleon-like” of the three subtypes. This strategy supposes a break with spontaneity. Control replaces trust, and the E3 Social becomes rigid and frozen.
summary: This chunk explains how the Social E3 equates identity with external image, leading to a chameleon-like adaptability across social contexts, but at the cost of inner connection, spontaneity, and authenticity.

title: Social E3: The Illusion of Recognition and Existential Emptiness
text:
Despite all his efforts to “make it”, he finds it difficult to feel recognized. In his struggle to be looked at and taken into account, he takes great care of his appearance and the pursuit of brilliance, avoiding conflicting and painful situations. When he receives any external evaluation, it is not fully believed, because there is no identity to support it, living on recognition for what he has done and not for what he is. This prevents the consummation of real contact with the world.

The gaze of others is always present, even if it is an internally fantasized gaze. Social E3, when looking in the mirror, sees himself through the eyes of his potential “audience”. At work, you imagine the evaluation of your boss or an abstract judge. In your tastes, although you may fight for your own, you are still aware of what your partner’s, your friend’s... the other’s are, and feel the urge to give up yours.
summary: This chunk highlights the Social E3’s chronic insecurity despite external success: they doubt recognition, live through others’ eyes, and suppress their true preferences, resulting in a lack of genuine contact with the world.

title: Social E3: Mercantilist Orientation and Existential Falsehood
text:
This subtype has a marked mercantilist orientation. It gets its value from the confirmation that others give it when they recognize its attributes. The important thing is to achieve the goals: social relationships have value to the extent that his achievements allow, and there is no real interest in others, but sociability is in maintaining a network that serves them, with no limits to the strategies for selling his product. The social context is a buyer’s market, where he is capable of being a great car salesman or spiritual workshop. He is the classic politician who knows how to show the right face to get votes. It is never really publicized, something you may be aware of:

The Social E3 has a basic existential falsehood; he imagines he is good without being so, identifies with his ideal, but is somewhat aware that he is not as perfect as he would like. He knows that he is showing something that he is not. He lives as if it were not his. For example, me, with my new house: “I see it more on my own when I show it to others, but when I’m alone I don’t feel this way. Here is the emptiness”.
summary: This chunk portrays the Social E3 as treating relationships and self-worth as transactional, recognizing an internal gap between their projected image and inner experience, illustrated by the personal example of feeling empty despite outward success.

title: Social E3: Materialism and the Performance of Worth
text: The desire for recognition is incessant and often takes the form of narcissistic material possessions: watches, houses, cars, etc. It’s like saying to the world over and over again “Look at what I’m wearing: that’s what I’m worth”. Modern ways of showing their high status are the collection of belongings for select groups, books dedicated by illustrious personalities, participation in workshops given by so-and-so and Mengano, etc.
summary: This chunk describes how the Social E3 uses material possessions and status symbols as repetitive affirmations of self-worth, treating recognition as a performance tied to external displays rather than internal value.

title: Social E3 as a product of consumerist culture and narcissistic authority dynamics
text:
Heis a character who perfectly represents the historical and social moment where the current promise of happiness is to have money and power, and as something that is achieved simply by acts of will. Today's Culture tries to convey that happiness is in purchasing power, in the “famous” economic and business development. The human being in his or her intimate needs is not considered part of the equation, nor part of nature, and consciousness is limited to individual benefit. This blindness is maintained through superficial stimuli and false needs. The Social E3 are the most adept and obtuse customers of shopping centers, with their compulsive shopping, or the politicians most adjusted to this age of nihilism.

He is a narcissistic character, like E7, and from this position it is very easy for him to believe that he has the greatest right, as described in DSM IV: “The narcissist feels so important that he can speak with the highest authority”.

E3 Social , when he refers to authority, he does so from a prior assessment of who the authority itself is. If he considers it to be a lesser god within his scale of values, he disqualifies it and may not pay the slightest attention to it. It is also very easy for him to rebel against her or “cut her head off”, as they say in therapeutic jargon, by seeking out her faults and making them public in strategic places.

He is intelligent enough, however, to know how to relate to various kinds of hierarchies and constantly seeks recognition from authority, placing himself in strategic places to be seen and valued. His dreaded scene is the failure to be recognized “from above”. When this happens, he feels very bad, although he hides it as best he can to preserve his image; I would like to disappear before facing such failure. As Yolanda says: “My feelings of failure are channeled with an automatic, hearty laugh that comes out of me without being able to help it. It is a hysterical laugh”. This is the easiest trait for the fake smile, so common in Enneatype Three in general.
summary: This chunk describes the Social E3 as shaped by a consumerist culture that equates happiness with wealth and power, highlighting their narcissistic relationship with authority—simultaneously rebelling against and seeking validation from hierarchical figures—while masking inner fragility with performative confidence and forced laughter.

title: Instrumental intelligence and manipulative relationships in Social E3
text:
A trait of the Social E3 is the seeming of knowledge, but not so much as something pleasurable, but as a form of exercising power. It is an instrumental use of intelligence, at the service of his passion to shine socially, especially for having an image of control and competition in front of the group. Thus Francesco comments: “At the bottom of my behaviour in life is always social power. In politics, in my social life...”.

His strategy is based on getting things done. Sensitive to the needs of others, he offers them what they need, but in a manipulative way, without genuine interest, but out of arrogance. And if the other becomes an obstacle to his goals, he mistreats or destroys him mercilessly (just as the Enneatype Eight puts the satisfaction of his supposed needs before any relationship and feelings).

His feelings also turn out to be so falsified that we can say that he feels “what he needs to feel”; this is why we count him among the cold and rational emotional characters. Francesco acknowledges his relationship with women of high economic status and his personal process of change:

“I have always lived with women of a much higher socioeconomic status than myself, of much greater prestige. I was very successful with wealthy women. With my wife, 40% of my attraction to her was because of her personal attractiveness and 60% was because she came from a rich and important family. At the time I didn’t realize this; it was years later. When I realized it, I felt terrible and started to doubt whether I really loved her; we had a couple crisis. I realized that through my partner I gave myself the prestige that I lacked. And when I don’t need her, I see that I want her for herself. If I can love her without needing her, that is love. I achieved that through inner work”.
summary: This chunk explores how the Social E3 uses intelligence instrumentally to gain social power, engages in manipulative relationships devoid of authentic emotion, and illustrates this through Francesco’s candid reflection on loving partners for status rather than person, revealing a journey toward authentic love through self-awareness.

title: Social E3’s compulsive performance and neurotic need for external validation
text:
Social E3s are ambitious and competitive, very determined to get what they want, and they calculate cruelly. The goal is always put before the relationship. Although their world is that of relationships, of cell phones, of media networks, of photos that testify to the thousands of places they have visited and people they have met. The experience of being in a relationship, or in life itself, is not based on an inner trust that is integrated into your person, but needs to be documented concretely in photographic images because only what you see exists.

CHAPTER 2; THE CHARACTERISTIC NEUROTIC NEED

by Eustaquio Garcia, translated by Mel

The neurotic need, which replaces the real need to feel the fullness of life and self-realization, is to shine, to have prestige; the social E3 seeks to please and please in order to gain an appreciative gaze.

The social E3 child was valued for what he did, and reinforced by applause. Thus was born the need to repeat achievements to continue obtaining that evaluative look.

“At school I had to do very well. I still remember when he told me: “If you're good, you'll get the scholarship.” I won the scholarship every year. Mom wanted me to study music, piano; for dad, sport was a great school. I liked everything that I knew they liked. I studied piano and excelled at sports: baseball, basketball, swimming... I knew I was a beautiful girl, but the only words I remember from Dad about my appearance were: “If you lose weight, you'll be better.”

Brilliance is sought in action, in acting to cause a good appearance and thus obtain an idea of success of oneself, especially in the material, in the obvious; hence the importance of money and status.
summary: This chunk outlines the Social E3’s compulsive need to perform and be seen, where self-worth is contingent on external validation through achievements, appearances, and documentation of success, rooted in childhood conditioning that equated love with accomplishment and prescribed neurotic pursuit of prestige as a substitute for authentic self-realization.

title: Поведенческие стратегии социального E3 для получения одобрения
text: If a person does not feel seen, he will need to do something to be seen, he will use more credentials, he will be more charming. The social E3, the brightness fixes it on the appearance, on the objects of prestige and beauty, socially qualified from and for the other, not felt from within: “When you enter a restaurant, you prefer not to look at the others – says Ana – because you don't want to check reality, you want to stay with the fantasy that they look at you!” Yolanda tells us about it:  “If I get to a group and I feel like no one is looking at me, I pretend I don't care, but I know perfectly well who I like, who may be a competitor, who I don't like, and who I may not like. I try to go unnoticed but I know they're looking at me. I try to be discreet but attractive, well composed without being vulgar or stunning, pretending that this is natural for me; Even if I'm disheveled, it's not spontaneous.”
summary: Описывает, как социальный E3 стремится быть замеченным через внешние проявления успеха, привлекательность и социальную маскировку, избегая реального контакта с собой и другими, предпочитая фантазию о том, что на него смотрят с одобрением.

title: Стоимость блеска и внутренняя усталость социального E3
text: Showing even a failure or weakness properly can result in a sales success. The alleged weakness ends up feeding the ego. The "no" and "I don't know" do not usually appear in their vocabulary, because they do not sell.  The cost of shining is high; the person tries hard without seeming so, but he arrives at the end of the day exhausted: “I don't know what's wrong with me; I'm tired!” he can be heard saying. It is allowed to be tired or sick on the weekends, and also during the holidays.  His neurosis is aimed at showing himself “from above”; it is a bloated passion, like enneatype Two, with the difference that E2 is filled with being proud that it is he who has value in himself, while social E3 is filled with being considered brilliant by others. Like the E2, the social E3 lacks the humility and, above all, the authenticity necessary to recognize that his “superior” position is a neurotic avoidance mechanism, rather than simply being the person he is. Avoid contact with the fear of not being recognized or valued socially, which is its source of neurotic nutrition.
summary: Объясняет, как социальный E3 использует даже слабость как инструмент успеха, избегает признания незнания и усталости, поддерживая образ brillante через постоянное напряжение, которое скрывает внутреннюю пустоту и страх непризнания.

title: Иллюзия контроля и экзистенциальная пустота социального E3
text: That of the social E3 is a passion at the service of not contacting the lack of value and the impossibility of heading towards a personal fulfillment supported by the satisfaction of its own desires, projects and values. Lacking contact with their inner world, with its depth, self- realization is transformed into the need to conform to what the social market demands. Fattening this passion lived as a need, attached to the external objective that it wants to achieve, the social E3 perpetuates the disconnection with its own interiority, keeping itself at a distance and in self- repression.  The neurotic illusion is that the desired social status allows him not to feel the emptiness of internal references, neither to relate to others nor to love himself. In this way, he manages not to touch the fear and depression that would come from this contact with his truth. He therefore passionately seeks to shine, imagining thus finding his place in the world. Glitter, money and power are energetic drugs that give you strength and excitement to continue living with a thousand tasks, a thousand relationships, to feel that you have a full life, so as not to run into failure.  He cannot allow himself to get tired because tiredness would be a time of emptiness, a silence in which the monster could wake up and raise its head.  Behind its perpetual movement, disconnected from authentic feelings, lies an attempt to control constant anxiety and, more deeply, the dark hole of meaninglessness in life itself. It is a narcissistic will, determined only to achieve the reflection of that ideal Self, with the arrogance of being able to determine events. It is impossible for him to stay in the here and now, to flow with what is happening. He lives in the grandiose fantasy that the world can be controlled and determined, relationships as well as nature:
summary: Раскрывает, как социальный E3 заменяет внутреннюю реализацию внешним блеском, используя успех как защиту от экзистенциальной пустоты, живя в иллюзии контроля и избегая контакта с подлинными чувствами и страхами.

title: Мистификация успеха и идентификация с ложным образом у социального E3
text: I always tried very hard, and I had found a wonderful trick to succeed. I knew that if I rushed through everything I had to do in a day, I would never get it done. So this is what I would do, the night before, before I went to sleep, I would make a quick plan of what I envisioned for the next day, and then I would break it down into micro-steps. Each one was practically independent of the other, but essential for the next stage. And each one in itself was feasible, while the great project as a whole seemed enormous. In this way, I focused my attention only on each specific phase, without really forgetting the great final project, which guided me and marked my direction, and thus, stage by stage, I was able to achieve great goals. Sometimes it takes a long time; I get impatient with the small steps, but I respect the big phases, with patience. It's just a matter of time.”  In the social E3, more than in the other subtypes, the mystification of substituting existential and spiritual vitality with egoic actions is made explicit. The false superficial mask is experienced as the authentic reality; the person is totally identified with her personality.  It is interesting to remember the term that Ichazo used for enneatype Three: Ego-go. It seems that the passion that Naranjo identified for the social E3, prestige, perfectly represents this living going; going towards the glitter of gold believing it to be light. The neurotic need has completely replaced the deep need to be. The surface has become substance, and is constantly polished and adorned. The social E3 invents itself, just as it invents stories, anecdotes and experiences to build the character. To the point that the lies can no longer be recognized.
summary: Описывает, как социальный E3 создает иллюзию продуктивности через детальное планирование, полностью идентифицируя себя с внешним образом успеха, где стремление к престижу заменяет подлинное бытие, а личность становится выдуманной конструкцией.

title: Давление образа и отрицание реальности у социального Э3
text:
Deceiving himself and his surroundings that the only existing reality is the one he can appear to be, and that he thinks is the one the world asks of him, he comes to deny or forget the existence of an internal reality, and also of an external reality that has a life of its own, regardless of what he can “build.”

Therefore, he learns to manage his interpersonal relationships and with the world from an incessant construction of himself. His experiences, thoughts and behaviors crystallize around the basic belief that he can direct people and events through his activities and his will.
summary: Описывается, как социальный Э3 отрицает внутреннюю и внешнюю реальность, идентифицируя себя с конструируемым образом, и верит, что может контролировать людей и события через свою волю и действия.

title: Фиксация на образе и вера в силу «делать»
text:
The fixation of the false image of oneself in the social subtype of E3 is based on the belief that presenting an image that the group or the context can approve of is the only way to be able to be in the world, to belong and be accepted.

The E3 has a basic belief that you can, with your will, change not only events but also people. An idea connected with the conviction that he can “do” something to achieve his ends. Doing has extreme power. So much so that it can lose its value as an instrument for a specific goal to become, in itself, a pillar of his style of being in the world.  In his continual need to fill life with doing, he loses sight of the meaning of his actions; or rather, the only meaning left is to occupy a highly visible position of prestige. It is an incessant work and without awareness of the incredible effort involved, because the addiction to success does not allow you to feel tired. It could be explained as a version of the generalized theory in this enneatype of: “if I do, I exist” which, in the specific case of the social E3 sounds like: “If I do important things and of socially recognized success, I exist”. With this philosophy, the social E3 builds its sense of identity and its vision of things.
summary: Социальный Э3 основывает свою идентичность на одобрении образа группой, верит в всесилие своей воли и действия, заменяя смысл действий на поиск престижа и видимости успеха.

title: Нарциссизм, иллюзия контроля и иррациональные идеи
text:
We can understand how this way of thinking reveals a narcissistic and omnipotent self- image, allowing the social E3 to deceive itself about the power it has over: its life, believing that it can manage it independently of external reality. Lacking confidence in his value as a person, he neurotically trusts the efficacy of his actions, the power of his maneuvers. He is convinced that his success depends on his will, without taking into account that others and the whole world have their own paths apart from him. But this is how it is believed that you can avoid any experience of failure or feeling of helplessness. You can't flow with the facts of life, still less with your own sensations and emotions; you can't trust because that would be losing control.

Around the distorted cognitive core that we have just described, he develops a set of “crazy” ideas, that is, irrational and disconnected from reality. It is believed, in particular, that he will achieve the satisfaction of his needs - to be successful - through adaptation, either in personal relationships or in the social context, coming to conform to the customs or fashions of the moment, in the belief that if you adopt a fashionable dress or thought, success is assured.

His social vanity feeds on irrational ideas about how he will achieve prestige, success and power.

One of them, as we have seen, is to have anything that makes it look powerful. Whether it's objects, houses or friends, “having is power.” There is an idea of being rich, of having things so as not to need and not have to ask, because they do not want to show any fragility or impotence. The social E3 becomes a user: it does not ask clearly; makes others feel guilty (projective identification) when his needs or desires are not satisfied, which are unclear to himself and even less so to the other. But he takes it for granted that others have to know what he needs and agree to be used for his purpose.
summary: Социальный Э3 развивает нарциссическое самоощущение и иллюзию всесилие, верит в контроль через действия и possession, использует манипуляции и проективную идентификацию для удовлетворения потребностей в успехе и власти.

title: Стратегии власти и лидерства через ассоциирование и conformism
text:
The social E3 assumes a leadership of organization and structure, but it holds up worse in the front row, as a leader, where it would be necessary to put up with whatever could fall on it (hostility, envy, failure...) for occupying the position of maximum power. He is attached to power, but a little in the rear, supported by the belief that the company of someone important is enough to be important himself. An example of a power strategy associated with having is offered by Francesco: «At one point in my life, when my father died, I said to myself: „I will never be poor‟. I'm not interested in being very rich, I just want not to be poor. What really interests me is having a lot of power, power itself.”

Francesco, Haydée and Yolanda see in money a means to access a higher class, a higher status: “If I have money, I'm worth it.”

In interpersonal relationships, the social E3 seeks consensus from emotion, and it does so by perceiving group needs and conforming to them as a consensual strategy. It could be said that his leadership is of an empathic type, but of an empathy that he uses strategically to be recognized, less seductive than that of E2. In the process of building trust, he can lose authority, being an emotional leader but not very directive.

Leadership serves him to speculate and manipulate; He looks for the right moment to say things and can be stubborn, rigid and repetitive, insisting endlessly for his own ends. Francesco recounts: “I learned to be false. I learned to appear much bigger and better than I was, and actually subdued the rich kids. Socioeconomically, I was the last in my school, and I compensated for it with my strategic ability to become the best, the leader of the rich.
summary: Социальный Э3 ищет власти через ассоциацию с важными людьми и материальные символы статуса, использует эмпатию как инструмент признания, прибегая к манипуляции и лжи для достижения лидерства и признания.

title: Иррациональные идеи в терапии и магия как компенсация
text: In therapy, one of his crazy ideas is to do magic, miracles with the patient. The E3 social therapist, despite his rationality, thinks he's great. Having the status of “therapist” already satisfies his need to feel “superior”.
summary: Даже в профессиональной роли терапевта социальный Э3 видит в статусе источник превосходства и верит в свою способность творить «чудеса», что отражает его иррациональную потребность в ощущении значимости и контроля.

title: Эмоциональная диссоцииация и вымысел как компенсация
text:
Another irrational idea is related to emotional disidentification, that is, the lack of real depth with respect to oneself. By not being in touch with his authentic emotions, the social E3 loses the ability to distinguish between what he feels and what is appropriate to feel, in the context or in the relationship; nor does he distinguish between the falsity created by himself and reality. This is how he also manages his internal emotional world: taking advantage of the emotions that may come from the other, or inventing emotions that he ends up believing and living as his own. This is how Ana explains it:

“I need fiction to feed on life. My own life has seemed so many times gray, unreal, bland, that I have sought to compensate for it by feeding myself, especially, on cinema, because fiction is more real than life itself, where I have more derealization. The cinema fills me with the intensity and emotional depth that I lack in my day to day. It gives me the sensation of reality that life of its own does not give me. In my normal life, my containment doesn't let me get emotional like that, because I don't want to feel sorry for myself or be weak.”
summary: Описывает, как социальный E3 теряет связь с подлинными эмоциями, заменяя их вымышленными или заимствованными переживаниями, используя художественную выдумку (вроде кино) как способ компенсации внутренней пустоты и чувства unreality.

title: Недоверие как проекция внутренней неуверенности
text: Another crazy E3 social idea has to do with mistrust. This character has disidentified from his being and, in the absence of real referents, doubts. Without roots, “he doesn't stand up”, and then he distrusts himself so much that he transfers this suspicion to others. In Francesco's words: “A good enemy is worth more than a bad friend. You know what the interests of your enemy are and you can agree with him, but with your friends you never know what hidden agenda they carry.”
summary: Объясняет, как отсутствие внутренней опоры и идентичности у социального E3 приводит к хроническому сомнению в себе, которое проецируется на других в виде всеобщего недоверия, даже к друзьям.

title: Страх бедности и одиночества как основа невроза
text:
The ideas that scare the most in social E3 are not succeeding or being poor. Both fears are related to having to ask or not having: money, power or prestige; in short, with contact with the impotence of his doing. The power that work, money or prestige give you is also associated with the fear of loneliness, and the irrational belief that they will leave you if you are not interesting or if you have nothing to give. He feels that for himself, for what he is, they do not love him. For Yolanda, “the crazy idea would be: „If I don't have anything to offer, I'm alone; if they don't need me, they don't want me; They need me if I have something to give‟.”

Eustaquio's most feared scene: “What was tremendous to me, was being homeless, begging on the street. The abandonment, that they do not see you”. For Ana, “it would hurt a lot if others saw me as a parasite, dirty, unpleasant, complaining... Well, my crazy idea is: „If I don't have money, I can't exist‟.” Francesco's fear is “to die alone, without anyone, so my neurotic belief is that if I am important I will never be alone.” Haydée and Ana have said to each other many times: “I don't need anything from anyone, and I can handle everything.”
summary: Раскрывает核心 страхи социального E3: бедность, незаметность и одиночество, которые связаны с убеждением, что любовь и принятие зависят от полезности, статуса и материального успеха, а не от самого человека.

title: Проблемы аутентичности и самоконтроля в терапии и отношениях
text:
It is important for his transformation that the social E3 stays in touch with the emotion and is consistent with it, even if that means there is no consensus in the group. His typical misguided strategy is to sacrifice his true emotion for the group, in order to maintain his emotional leadership, at the cost of stepping over himself.

With children or adolescents it is easy for him to get authoritarian, but with adults who are equal to or above him he cannot resort to authority, and that is why he seeks consensus, confirming the crazy idea that the most important thing is to be confirmed and only by achieving it can he be accepted and loved.

This character imposes authority in a way that he himself considers inadequate. Despite his great and constant efforts at self-control and adaptation, the mechanism fails and he can “lose face”, embarrassingly getting out of control.
summary: Описывает внутренний конфликт социального E3 между необходимостью бытьauthentic и стремлением сохранить статус через подавление эмоций, что приводит к неудачным попыткам контроля и потере лица в социальных взаимодействиях.

title: Адаптивность как маскировка внутренней неполноценности
text:
The social E3 tends excessively to adapt to the environment, feeling, however, inadequate inside. In relationships with others there is confluence, adaptation, adequacy, chameleonism or “adaptive faculty: it sounds better”. Yolanda adds this nuance:

“We give the feeling of „I can‟ and of „I don't need others to give me: I procure it for myself.‟ In any case, we are the ones who can help others. If someone helps us, we feel bad and we have to return that „ballast‟ to feel free of debt. Faced with the irrational idea of having to do the task and do it well, fatigue appears, what is happening
to us, and puts us in conflict: reality versus ideal.”
summary: Описывает склонность социального E3 к чрезмерной адаптации к окружению (хамелеонизм) как компенсацию внутреннего чувства недостаточности, при этом помощь воспринимается как долг, а успех — как источник внутреннего конфликта между реальностью и идеалом.

title: Юмор и саморазоблачение как защитные механизмы
text: He finds it difficult to laugh at himself, although humor would decriminalize his clumsiness, but he feels very embarrassed when a fault is pointed out to him or he is ridiculed; he experiences it as a failure, a clumsiness. Environments like the Gestalt one suit him very well, where self-denouncement is rewarded. It also helps to take it with humor if someone catches you in your neurosis. In fact, humor is a hook that the social E3 casts wherever it fishes; he laughs at himself before others do; It's not to lose control. He acknowledges Francesco: “I realize how much I exploit self-denunciation. I can't refrain from showing my weakness but I do it by exploiting it, for seductive purposes”.
summary: Объясняет, как социальный E3 использует юмор и преднамеренное саморазоблачение не для принятия слабости, а как соблазнительную стратегию контроля над впечатлением и избежания потери лица, превращая уязвимость в инструмент манипуляции.

title: Демогогия и пустота речи как способ избежания глубины
text:
Noteworthy in this subtype is their ability to speak without saying much, in an vacuous, demagogic manner. It measures the time or, better said, the attention of the public, to whose fluctuations it adapts naturally.

The social E3 (like the other two subtypes) assumes so many identities because it very quickly “understood” that, being what it is, it is worthless. At one point in the work of this group, Haydée became emotional remembering the shame she felt at having considered her vulgar parents. We entered into a deep emotion but we sustained it for a short time; we wanted to recover soon and we filled it with words. If we hadn't, the hole would have been so deep it would be scary to drop into it. It could have been a very intimate moment but too much emotion cannot be sustained.
summary: Подчеркивает тенденцию социального E3 к поверхностной, демгогичной речи, направленной на удержание внимания plutôt чем на передачу смысла, избегая глубоких эмоций, которые кажутся опасными и невыносимыми из-за внутреннего ощущения собственной никчемности.

title: Страх подлинности и механизмы адаптации у социального E3
text:
When he really speaks, and not from his head, the social E3 gets scared. It feels very vulnerable when it's authentic, and it doesn't take long to recover, to falsify again. He fights with emotion from the crazy idea that emotion is weakness, and he, it is clear, cannot allow himself to be weak, because in his childhood showing his fragility was not reinforced but penalized. His false belief is that you have to be strong, understanding strength as control of emotion or toughness. Eustaquio recalls:

“The feeling of shame is deep: especially when it escapes us, and the others see, „our inner monster‟, in its different faces: the egoist who doesn't really care about others, the one who doesn't know, our coldness, our decomposed rage... I entered this whole world of psychotherapy when I was already about twenty-five years old. It was a personal growth group; we were in the typical gestalt circle and the therapist asked me: „And you, what do you feel?‟ In addition to not knowing, not having contact with what I felt, it was tremendous for me. Someone was interested in how I felt!”
summary: Описывает страх социального E3 перед подлинностью и аутентичностью из-за детских переживаний, когда проявление слабости наказывалось, а не поддерживалось. Приводится цитата Eustaquio о стыде и первом опыте в психотерапии, где он столкнулся с вопросом о своих чувствах.

title: Потребность адаптации и потеря спонтанности у социального E3
text:
For E3 social, the adaptation to the environment matters too much. His fear of stepping out of line, of being inadequate, an intruder or a nuisance makes him always measure his own limit and that of others. He cares so much about controlling and not showing that he controls... But it shows a lot! Deep down, the experience of not being able to control puts the person of this subtype facing the unknown, not knowing who he is and what he wants, the lack of tools to live with others. As Haydée relates:

“When I was with older girls as a child, I only intervened when I was very sure. If not, I remained silent and attentive, to imitate what I liked most about each one. Even today, if I am in an environment that I consider superior, I shut up and listen.”

The need to adapt to the environment makes it impossible for him to contact spontaneity. Being spontaneous means letting yourself be seen for what you are, and what you think you are is of little value or may turn out to be wrong; better to seduce by adapting. Inside he feels the tension and dissonance, at which point he feels lost. Giusy felt “very adequate and very inadequate at the same time. I think that the social E3s have the feeling of being inadequate in the group, and at the same time we do everything to adapt to the context, to adapt.”

The context fulfills a mirror function where the social Three can be reflected and “construct” a sense of identity. The reflection that was missing in childhood is still looking for it in the group, adapting to the image that it gives back: “If I am what I see that you want, I can be with you.”
summary: Анализирует чрезмерную потребность социального E3 в адаптации к окружению из-за страха быть недостаточным или неприемлемым. Это приводит к потере спонтанности, внутреннему напряжению и использованию группы как зеркала для построения идентичности, которой не хватало в детстве.

title: Чувство неполноценности и внешняя ориентация у всех подтипов E3
text: All E3 subtypes have a feeling of being stupid; perhaps because what they do does not come from within. They look outside what the need of the environment is and fulfill it, but they have a lot of difficulty in knowing what theirs is. As Giusy recalls: “In my family women were supposed to do women's things; they were not to think for themselves.” Yolanda has realized that “before the sessions, I made an index of what I wanted to work on that day in therapy. I came with the scheme, I decided the whole process so as not to feel stupid or in a vacuum”. Haydée went to therapy “without feeling bad; I didn't feel lacking or needed, I was „overloaded‟. In fact, I started in the third year of gestalt training because otherwise they wouldn't give me the title.”
summary: Объясняет, что все подтипы E3 испытывают чувство неполноценности или «глупости», поскольку их действия исходят из внешних ожиданий, а не внутренних потребностей. Приводятся личные примеры Giusy, Yolanda и Haydée, иллюстрирующие эту внутреннюю пустоту и стремление избежать ощущения бесцельности через структурирование терапии.

title: Эмпатия, подстройка под других и избегание конфликта у социального E3
text:
This very emotional character easily detects the emotions of others and, to be on the front line, is concerned with reaching consensus, when it would be more convenient for him to remain at his center and defend his opinion, regardless of what others think. According to Lowen, the psychopath, corresponding to E3, does things well so as not to be caught at fault. In this regard, Ana says:

“Being used to fulfilling the expectations of another, it is not easy to know when it comes to my own wishes. I think I protect my therapist from myself, so she doesn't feel incompetent. I offer him some progress, some insight when it seems to me that he feels we are stuck and he can take responsibility for not doing well enough. What I need most from her is that she accepts me, listens to me, supports me and points things out to me without attacking or judging me: a good and wise mother. If, as an E3 patient, you show the therapist a mask and he believes it and makes no effort to go further, I think the therapy can no longer work.”
summary: Описывает, как социальный E3 легко считывает эмоции других и стремится к консенсусу, подавляя собственное мнение. Приводится цитата Ana о том, как она защищает терапевта от собственных потребностей, предлагая прогресс, чтобы избежать ощущения его некомпетентности, и подчеркивает необходимость принятия без осуждения для терапевтического прогресса.

title: Контроль, конкуренция и пассивная агрессия у социального E3
text:
From his adaptation mechanism, and wanting to please, the social E3 insists on this extreme control over the other and his relationships, with the idea that he can control everything and, with that, avoid his insecurity, aggression, non-acceptance.

The tacit competence of the social E3 is revealed in this anecdote from Ana about her therapy:

“I arrive at the sessions more or less with what I want to work with. I leave no room for silence. The first day of consultation I almost sat in the chair of the therapist. (They were two of the same, but even so, surely I must have perceived something that indicated that this was his.)”

His competition is a blind strategy for himself, hidden as he is behind seductive and apparently docile strategies. When he feels that he is not going to win, he can “cut off the head” of the winner. Another way to handle the challenge is to ally with the one he perceives as the enemy. But he will preferably withdraw from the competition, feigning disinterest, and hiding the feeling of internal failure or embarrassment behind the disconnected mask. For him, indifference is much better than fighting. When the social E3 doesn't know how to relate, or he feels that he doesn't like something, or that he isn't going to get liked, he gets cold with the other. It is an aggressive indifference, which disqualifies the opponent and makes him feel that his is not valid. It is the invalidation of one's own projected onto the other.
summary: Раскрывает, как социальный E3 использует контроль и адаптацию как стратегию избежания собственной неуверенности и агрессии. Описывается его скрытая конкуренция: от саботажа противника до feigned indifference как формы пассивной агрессии, направленной на дискредитацию другого и защиту собственного хрупкого self-образа.

title: Authority and Recognition in Social E3
text: For social E3 there are only a handful of authority figures who deserve to be recognized as such... and sometimes, just because of the power they hold. Highly hierarchical and normative, they have an excellent detector for power, that is, who is worth recognizing, to get what they want. If he manages to seduce authority, standing out from others, he feels powerful. At best, being recognized by authority makes it easier for him to develop the values of dedication and loyalty.
summary: This chunk describes how social E3 individuals relate to authority figures, emphasizing their hierarchical nature, sensitivity to power dynamics, and how recognition from authority supports their development of dedication and loyalty.

title: Competitive and Ruthless Ambition
text:
CHAPTER 4; CHARACTERISTIC TRAITS AND PSYCHODYNAMICS

translated by Mel

Competitive

“Anything goes to stay on Olympus”, Juanjo Herrera will say when analyzing the film “Eva al desnudo”. In the machinery put to the service of its basic objective: success and social recognition, this subtype displays the most powerful and unprincipled competitiveness.

The forms that competition takes may be appropriate, but the substance is ruthless. The social E3, in its self-image as good, hides all the manipulative action aimed at destroying the opponent through tricks and lies. It is rarely going to be confronted directly; it will always be with more or less subtle denigrations. Power is exercised from the shadows with a smile and without disheveled hair, avoiding any space of intimacy. Their efforts are aimed at not losing their good image and social position, through their social attractiveness and friendliness, rather than good performance of tasks. All his efforts are focused on maintaining a leading role that allows him to control the situation.

Envy is one of the silent engines of his action. At work he will go after his ambitions with crude chameleon tricks and showing his “merchandise” at all times: what he has or with whom he is related. He will also use his sight to detect the one who has the power, which he will access through the right silence, the right word, the appropriate action that he imagines may please him. Once a place of recognition has been achieved, the struggle continues, now seeking constant adaptation so as not to lose the privileges achieved. He can have no limit here to trample on anyone, or to build lies that invalidate whoever interferes in his path to the podium. This is one of the character traits that best evidences his connection to E8, along with revenge.
summary: This chunk explores the competitive nature of social E3, highlighting their ruthless ambition, manipulative tactics to maintain image and power, use of envy as motivation, and connections to E8 traits like revenge and dominance through indirect aggression.

title: Vengeful and Histrionic Reactions
text:
Vengeful

If he fails to achieve his objective, or is discovered in his fraud or in his true intentions, he tries to maintain a good image; there will be an opportunity to exact a cold revenge where everything will be worth it. The manipulation of information, smear and slander are frequently used in this subtype. The strategic lies to discredit the other are so well concocted that he himself loses the notion of the limit between reality and

fiction.

Histrionic

The social E3 remains unperturbed to not touch or show his anger and pain. His armor is therefore not to lose the forms or show signs of emotional weakness. So how does he express the histrionic trait? Well, through impatience, its disguised form of anger. That of not getting what he wants when he wants: that is what destabilizes his unflappable attitude and draws the veil of his anger. If he doesn't manage to be the center of attention because his seduction is no longer worth it, he touches his limit; he does not tolerate this because his fraud is exposed and he is fired with dramatic and exaggerated outings that show his

intolerance.
summary: This chunk describes how social E3 responds to failure or exposure with cold, calculated revenge through manipulation and slander, and expresses histrionic traits not through overt emotion but via impatience and dramatic outbursts when denied attention or exposed.

title: Chameleonic Adaptation and Gender Inversion
text:
Chameleonic/Simultaneously multifaceted

We could call the social E3 simultaneously multifaceted. In everyday life he is capable of watering the plants, talking on the mobile and taking care of the roast in the oven while he eats an apple and thinks about the next thing he has to do.

In his perfect adaptation to the environment, he learns how to be in any situation, how to dress, what to eat and what to drink, and whether to shut up or speak. From control, it synthesizes what is most convenient and passes off as natural a behavior studied in detail, away from the slightest spontaneity.

Inverted masculinity and femininity

The social E3 woman has a lot of masculine energy (logical, rational, and action-oriented). She has not known how to take from the mother the tender, receptive energy; she didn't absorb the loving and protective part of her. She feels complicit among the men, like a colleague who helps them to be even more men. She admires strong guys and feels like a warrior with a hard shell to protect herself from everyone and everything.

The social E3 man does not learn to use the energy of the father, whom he looks at with fear, hiding his emotions. He has a more feminine appearance. And afraid of the strength of him; to make up for it he fantasizes himself as some kind of uptight guy. Among his friends he will seek out the strong and mighty.

Both men and women suffer from a dystonion: they associate force with violence, as with an out-of-control explosion. It is healthy for both to experience the strength of the masculine and the feminine in a group; allowing themselves to enter a space that is neither seductive nor competitive.
summary: This chunk details the social E3's chameleonic ability to adapt behavior precisely to contexts, and their inverted gender expression—women exhibiting masculine traits and men exhibiting feminine traits—stemming from repressed parental energies and a distorted view of strength as violence.

title: Manipulative Exchange and Appropriationist Creativity
text:
Manipulative when giving and receiving

The social E3 hates to feel indebted, so they feel that they must give more than they receive. It cannot even give to the same extent; he has to give more and, if he can, better. To make sure he's going to receive, he hits a commodity exchange where he has to come out on top. It is not about altruism, compassion or generosity; it is a strictly

commercial counterpart.

Appropriationist

The social E3 only moves on safe ground, based on what others have done. Analyze, filter, optimize and generate a new product with no room for inspiration. He does not trust being able to create for himself, being too ambitious and a controller overly concerned with the judgment of others. Giusy puts it very well: “Metaphorically, the creativity of a social E3 would be cut and paste.”

Avoidance of the experience of death
summary: This chunk explains how social E3 views giving and receiving as a calculated exchange where they must gain advantage, and describes their appropriationist creativity—relying on existing models rather than original inspiration—while introducing their avoidance of death as a core psychological theme.

title: Эмоциональная блокировка перед смертью
text:
Faced with death, the social E3 is emotionally blocked. He stops feeling, he freezes with a cold absence so as not to face the pain and sorrow.

This is how Francesco remembers the news of the attack that father surfed: “We did not know how he was, they did not give details of how the wounded were. I had a tremendous slump and I was completely frozen.” After cooling down, he chose anger, manifested outward or inward, rather than grief. He does not allow himself a space to cry, to loosen up; he is afraid to connect with the body, to feel the heart and overflow with emotion.

Death means for a social E3 the degradation of the body and the total loss of control. He associates it with the body becoming unpleasant, with “losing face.” Giusy remembers: “In a directed fantasy, I always saw myself dead, and I contacted the disgusting part of my body. Mice, insects, worms ate me; I felt rotten liquids oozing from my body.” Faced with the evidence of his own fragility, this character panics.

He is afraid of dying alone and of physical pain. The anguish that he perceives with the experience of death is processed without emotional content, defending himself with the mechanism of denial. He remains “in the denial of the fact, the first phase of mourning,” says Eustaquio. He avoids thinking about death from the omnipotent feeling that he will never die; death is a thing that happens to others. In cases where he has had a constant presence in the family environment, the feeling of being the bearer of death is generated in the social E3.

Until he loses a loved one, he does not become aware of his own mortality. The proximity of death, moments of physical danger, tragic news or illnesses prefer to process them rationally and, rather than break down in pain, they will focus on action. “With cancer I didn't miss a single day of work,” says Ana. To which Haydée adds: “A few minutes after my father died, I went to the phone and started making arrangements. My father died at 3:30 in the afternoon, and at six he was already in a funeral home eighty kilometers from home.”
summary: Описывает, как социальный тип E3 реагирует на смерть: эмоциональная блокировка, отрицание, рационализация, избегание боли и страха перед потерей контроля, а также осознание смертности только после личной потери.

title: Отношение к смерти и любовь в прощании
text:
As an adult, he associates death with an internal non-being, with an interior desert, with a cold, dry depression. If he allows himself to accompany a loved one in this transit, he experiences a quality of love that opens his heart, and then he lives a purity in delivery, a transcendental experience. “At my father's farewell I felt a lot of love, of a quality that is difficult to explain,” recalls Haydée.

The approach to death can also become something frivolous. The social E3, instead of mourning, think about what clothes to wear to the funeral. In some cases, the Hoffmann process has served to mourn all the deaths that had not been mourned at the time.
summary: Взрослый социальный E3 связывает смерть с внутренней пустотой, но при осознанном прощании может испытать трансцендентную любовь; также отмечается поверхностный подход к ритуалам смерти (например, выбор одежды) и использование терапии для обработки неоплаканных потерь.

title: Привязанность к деньгам и статусу
text:
Attached to money

The social E3 risks, even too much, but it is certain that in the face of economic risk it will know how to procure the means to maintain its status. He doesn't like to ask but he doesn't give up anything; try to get others to give you without having to openly ask for them.

He seeks from a young age to be financially independent. He doesn't keep an eye on his bank account, he doesn't save, and he spends more than he has. It is about spending, not about investing in things that later give revenue. He is generous with other people's money and more “greedy” when it comes to his own.

Another way of spending is indulging others with gifts, fine foods, etc., as a way of buying friendship. It is a question of generosity as a matter of image; “It is frowned upon not to be generous,” Yolanda clarifies. The social E3 tends to give the couple things that he actually likes but not necessarily the ortho. They are manipulative gifts: “„Look what I brought you...‟, and then it ends up in my room, or is it so that I can wear the perfume that I like.”

If living with austerity is what he takes, he will do it, facing the gallery, but he will have a Mercedes Benz in a parking lot not far from there. He rubs shoulders with powerful people with a higher purchasing power than his, and behaves with them as if they were from the same clan, a prisoner of internal insecurity. Although he does not have it, it seems that he has, because of the attitude of a rich patrician that he knows how to adopt. A social E3 would have a hard time obeying the mandate of a new Messiah who came with a “leave everything and follow me.”
summary: Описывает, как социальный E3 связан с деньгами: стремится к финансовой независимости, тратит больше, чем имеет, использует щедрость как инструмент имитажа, демонстрирует статус через possessions и притворство, избегая настоящей зависимости или жертвенности.

title: Привязанность к образу дома и скатологическая скромность
text:
Attached to the image of his house

A social E3 can't live anywhere; he looks for wide spaces that he decorates with his own style. His is a charming house. It is not only the place where he lives but also a showcase to show what he is and what he has. He enjoys receiving friends or important people who will appreciate the style that permeates every corner. He takes care of all the details and perfumes a house with flowers, candles and incense that oscillates between a
certain chaos and immaculate cleanliness.

Scatologically modest

This is a topic that a social E3 would prefer not to talk about. He is neat in his personal cleanliness, in some cases to the point of generating a reaction formation that leads him to wash himself several times a day. He would eliminate fart, snot, poo and pee, as it seems to him something very unpleasant that educated people do not show in public. Equipped with a discriminating sense of smell, he hates bad body odours.

He is usually constipated by a masochistic fixation that leads him to contain. He is able to get on with the task at hand rather than satisfy physiological needs. He keeps farting to himself, which is allowed only in an isolated bathroom, away from other ears, but if the evidence betrays it, he justifies it as “uncontrolled gas”, and if the fart is not his he suffers thinking that someone may suspect that it comes from him. When he is away from home he finds it difficult to defecate.
summary: Описывает, как социальный E3 использует дом как символ статуса и самовыражения, а также его сильное отвращение к телесным функциям, ведущее к гиперконтролю чистоты и подавлению естественных потребностей из страха перед социальным осуждением.

title: Соблазнение как социальная стратегия
text: Seductive
summary: Очень короткий фрагмент, вводящий тему соблазнения как части поведения социального E3; продолжается в следующем фрагменте.

title: Сексуальность и отношения у социального E3
text:
The social E3 is little passionate, little sexually active; sexuality puts him at the service of pleasing, until he is sure of being loved. It matters more to him to feel that the other likes him than the experience of sexuality itself. And he is more interested in seduction than deepening relationships. He has sex thinking about what the other likes, more than his own pleasure. Being a good lover becomes one more task and sex another product for sale. In the love encounter, before the orgasm, he feels fear of losing control, an interference that makes it difficult for him to give himself deeply in love.

If he connects with the instinctive part, he likes aggressive sex, which he filters as something dirty that he has to hide: he prefers a lover with whom he can unleash his beast and maintains a less exciting relationship with his partner.

Among men, problems of impotence, premature ejaculation, lack of desire and pain in the penis may arise; and among women there is a tendency to frigidity.
summary: Описывает сексуальное поведение и отношения социального E3: акцент на pleasing, страх потери контроля, использование секса как инструмента, подавление инстинктов и возможные сексуальные дисфункции.

title: Одежда и стиль как социальный инструмент
text:
Studied

The social E3 dresses himself giving meaning and attributes to clothing, which he turns into an instrument for his social movements. He dresses to please, he is striking in his appearance and daring in his shapes and colours. He has his own style, studied in detail so that he never goes unnoticed. Casual clothing and brands coexist in his wardrobe, and we can find everything from garments to go to the African jungle to the most elegant attire for a palatial dinner. He has the poise to show off his wardrobe and although the clothes are cheap they look expensive, because of the way he wears them.
summary: Объясняет, как социальный E3 использует одежду как средство самопрезентации и социального влияния: тщательно продуманный стиль, сочетание доступной и элитной одежды для создания впечатления статуса и успеха.
