title: Профессиональная независимость и манипуляция авторитетом
text:
Professionally independent

He tries to avoid bosses and strict schedules. For the social E3 it is very important to have freedom and, in the event that there is a boss, he tries to maintain his independence by seducing the authority: he already “sneaks in”, he measures his actions to gain spaces of power that give him certain privileges and, if he can, the boss will end up becoming a friend.
summary: Описывает стремление социального E3 к профессиональной автономии: избегание строгой иерархии, использование харизмы и уступок для нейтрализации влияния начальства и превращения его в союзника.

title: Страх, подавленная агрессия и самонаправленная violence
text:
Fearful/Embarrassing/Violent/Repressed

The social E3 denies fear, it skips it with action. “In my childhood and youth I was very afraid, and out of shame I masked it with counterphobic attitudes,” recalls Ana.

When he brings out his rage, he truly uses a precise and lethal scalpel. He lives with the feeling that there is in him a murderous instinct so great that, if he left it free, it would turn him into a criminal. “I feel so dark inside that I think he could kill; that's why I repress myself”, confesses Francesco. “When I feel an attack”, Haydée adds, “the first thing that comes out of me is total hatred and the desire to kill”. Giusy comments that at times she has felt diabolical and Yolanda says that, in her case, “rather than being aggressive as a first initiative, I am reactive, and I also tend to direct aggression towards myself. I am afraid of suicide.”
summary: Рассматривает внутренние конфликты социального E3: отрицание страха через гиперактивность, подавленную агрессию, страх собственной destructive impulses и тенденцию к самонаправленному насилию и suicidal мыслям.

title: Парадокс лени и переработки
text:
Lazy

A working social E3 forgets about its basic needs. He postpones eating, sleeping or going to the bathroom, in order to finish what he is up to. Despite spending all day doing things, he feels lazy. Says Ana:

“If I don't stop so much action it's because I think that if I stopped I would never get out of bed, never ever. And the way I work with the computer is like a kind of machine, a mantra. I can work eleven or twelve hours straight in front of the screen without even wondering if I'm tired.”

Eustaquio adds a nuance to this paradox: “We are trustworthy, hardworking, but outward, in outward tasks. But we do not take care of ourselves in the things that do us good for ourselves.” Ana agrees: “If you save it for your leisure, since leisure time never comes without homework, you don't do it.”

Laziness is mixed with a lack of discipline; It is difficult for him to maintain a commitment to himself, especially if it is something that belongs to the care of his spirit. The spirit is not something concrete, it is not seen, so he does not trust that it has a value. As forcefully as he is determined and striving in egoic actions, he neglects to remember the subtlest and deepest parts of himself.

This character becomes an expert in giving recommendations that he himself does not carry out, unless they are imposed as a task. As Francesco acknowledges:

“In front of the patients I pretend that I practice everything that I recommend; now there are twenty patients who have signed up for my dynamic meditation class... and this forces me to do it myself. Since it's work, then yes I do it. I play these tricks on myself to give me things that are good for me.”
summary: Описывает парадокс социального E3: внешняя продуктивность и работа до изнеможения сопровождаются внутренней ленью, пренебрежением самообслуживанием и духовными практиками, которые он советует другим, но не выполняет сам, пока они не становятся обязательной задачей.

title: Социальный E3 в отношениях и дружбе
text:
The social E3 knows a lot of people but has few friends. He tends to choose his friends from among the sexes he is attracted to, and his relationships are never disinterested. He has difficulty being with someone who is simply a friend, because deep down there is a mercantilist interest: if the other has money, power, prestige, wisdom, beauty... then he wants to have him as a friend. Look in friends for something that you can not only value but also use. He does not know how to go towards the other from the heart, he feels unarmed and vulnerable. “If you're going to introduce me to the President of the Republic,” admits Francesco, “it doesn't take me five minutes to show up. On the other hand, if you tell me: „Go make friends‟, I am very afraid and in tremendous anguish.”

By masking emotions, he can be envious and manipulative without being noticed. He can convey superiority in a veiled way when he is apparently extolling others. He expects the other to recognize and value him and rarely breaks this automatic mechanism and simply lets himself be and enjoy the friendship. He validates his prestige in terms of the other, as Giusy confirms:

“Without saying: I am a friend of so-and-so, without openly bragging about it, even feigning humility, I drop in the conversation (without saying it openly, but insinuating it) what my high- level contacts are, and with this I convey that I am a person of value. My patients are famous models, friends of Kennedy, etc.; the cream of my city.”
summary: Описывается социальный тип E3 в межличностных отношениях: склонность к утилитарному выбору друзей, маскировка эмоций, поиск подтверждения своей ценности через статус и связи, отсутствие искренности и уязвимость в глубинном общении.

title: Эмоции социального E3: зависть и ревность
text:
In relationships, he feels faithful even after being unfaithful. It is justified because she spends most of her time unconsciously seducing you infidelity. He breaks off a relationship from one day to the next because, up to that moment, he has maintained the impression that nothing was happening on the outside. He avoids confrontations and prefers to send his lawyer before putting on a show.

Envious

He envies the possession of objects but hardly something that he lacks inside, such is his internal disconnection that he only goes for the external. “Today,” says Francesco, “it is different for me: I see other good therapists and I would like to manage the therapeutic relationship as they do. But this is recent. Before, I wanted objects, things, and that didn't satisfy me: I bought them and felt just as empty. It was a fixation, it became something obsessive.” Giusy also speaks of envy:

“Let's imagine the situation: I'm with Eustaquio and Ana. Two women and one man. I couldn't compete with her openly; she would be embarrassing to me. So my strategy would be to speak as if I spoke well of her, but letting in manipulative comments, such as: «Ána is dangerous, a man- eater, be careful with her», and without clearly extolling myself, because then my vanity would be too much evident. Beneath this manipulative strategy is an envy that I deny.”

Jealous

Jealousy is aroused especially if he senses a rival. Which might seem normal, but it is that the social E3 deeply neglects his partner, from the lack of intimacy, stops looking at them, until someone who can threaten their place does not appear. Live the third in discord as someone who is worth more, or who is more beautiful, or who has something of great value, so not only is his love relationship at risk, but he can lose his power, his status, his importance, his prestige. The presence of a rival brings with it the monster of social failure.
summary: Анализируются эмоциональные паттерны социального E3: неверность оправданная самообманом, скрытая зависть направленная на внешние атрибуты статуса и ревность, связанная с угрозой социальному положению и имиджу.

title: Амбициозность и холодность социального E3
text:
Ambitious

His effort in social climbing and making a career is different from the ambition of the social E2. Both plan strategies and seduce people who can take them to a recognized place, but the E2 sells itself as great and expresses its generosity with great warmth, while the E3 sells its work or its organizational efficiency and, above all, its efforts, with a feeling of insecurity within himself. Play more at being useful and carefully study what you need to make multiple profits, but you always have to be correct and adequate.

Cold

Emotional coldness obviously has to do with disconnection from your affective world. She doesn't know what she feels and for him, feelings are more like obstacles that get in his way, instead of guides to choose what she wants and what she has to do. Similarly, although he can be empathic, he does not take into account the other's emotions, which are not on his map. People are objectified, accounting notes that he keeps between what he receives and what he gives. It's no wonder that in intensely painful situations he can appear unperturbed; he never loses the mask.
summary: Сравнивается амбициозность E3 и E2: E3 фокусируется на эффективности и неуверенности в себе, в отличие от теплой щедрости E2. Также описывается эмоциональная холодность E3 — дистанция от чувств, объектфикация людей и отсутствие внутренней направленности.

title: Нетерпеливость и отношение ко времени у социального E3
text:
Impatient

Time, for social E3 is the time you have to do your things or wait to achieve what you want. More than a time to live is a useful time. And it had better be quick, for it cannot tolerate a vacuum or inactivity. It is about a character pushed into the future (of his successes), a fantasized future or that he has to realize at full speed. Experiencing the here and now would mean for the social E3 to flow with life, to enjoy himself, but he has neither the confidence nor the hope that this will be enough to live on.
summary: Описывается нетерпеливость социального E3: время воспринимается как инструмент для достижения целей, неприемлемость простои, ориентированность на будущий успех и невозможность находиться в настоящем моменте из-за отсутствия веры в его достаточность.

title: Опыт эмоциональности у социального E3
text:
“I’ve been trying to write an autobiography for days, but I can’t. I have done things in my life depending on external circumstances, but not doing something that is really mine. They are things ‘borrowed’ for a certain moment. I can’t connect with my feelings, because it’s like nothing happened in my life.”

Something that Francesco confirms:

“It would be easier for me to talk about things while I live them. But when they have already passed and I go back over them, I do it without emotion, as if it happened to someone else. It’s easy to build a biography like a resume, with facts. Someone would have to interview me and ask about subjective experience and emotion. To the fact: ‘I graduated’, the interviewer could ask: ‘And how did you feel then?’”

“For me,” says Giusy, “expressing emotions meant running the risk of being humiliated, of being laughed at.” Sometimes, the emotional catharsis excuse of fiction is used to let go of their own emotions. “During the cancer,” says Ana, “sometimes I went to see movies with dramas of illness, so I could cry with that apology, because it contained me in respect of me; I didn’t want to sink myself by pitying myself.”
summary: Описывает эмоциональную диссоциацию у социального E3, когда они воспринимают свои переживания как чужие, не могут связаться с чувствами и используют внешние оправдания (например, искусство или болезнь) для доступа к эмоциям.

title: Эмоция через фантазию и самопрезентацию
text:
Emotion through fantasy

The social E3 is very energetic and its playfulness is bright, sparky and witty; at the service of self-promotion. Of all the E3 subtypes, the social one is the one that can most easily show negative emotions (sometimes it even gets confused with the E8). But its manifestation, in general, is regulated by its convenience to the situation. (Thus, in a gestalt group where direct emotionality is rewarded, she will show a strong record of what the therapist expects.) Yolanda illustrates how she learned to adjust her behavior to the expectations of the context: “At my mother’s funeral I began to sing, because many times we had sung together, and my father slapped me. I began to ask myself: ‘Ah, what is there to feel in this circumstance?’”

The emotion directs it towards what each situation or interlocutor demands.bIf they are emotional, the social E3 can be carried away by emotion and connect with its own affectivity.

Anger, when expressed, is not usually shown openly. It can be manifested, for example, with an irony that, although it can be caustic or even sadistic, is disguised as elegance. The aggression looks like an accident, or shows up on second reading; it leaves the one who threw the dart untouched.

E3 social fantasies often revolve around prestige. For example, with content of greatness, of being above, of belonging to a select group of powerful people. And he wants that to be noticed (to be seen from below). This can happen in the material aspect (generally with brand name objects), as Eusraquio mentions: “My brother gave me a very expensive watch. If I see a person who understands this, I roll up my sleeves so that my watch can be seen.” But it can also refer to more intangible fields of prestige: “It is in academic, intellectual credentials,” explains Ana, “where I place my social ambition. For example, what club do I belong to: I prefer it to be the best university. Or I pay attention to a favorable staging of my resume.”

However, the shadow of this glitter fantasy is a negative self-perception. Haydée talks about it as “another dark part, of feeling horrible, a thief, a liar, ugly.”
summary: Описывает, как социальный E3 выражает эмоции через фантазию о престиже, адаптируя поведение под ситуацию, подавляя гнев за иронией и строя образ через материальные и интеллектуальные символы статуса, при этом скрывая негативное self-представление.

title: Любовь и самовосприятие через партнера
text:
In love, the fantasy of prestige can be specified in having a partner, as Yolanda says, “pretty, let them look good”; someone flashy, to “show them off. They are the most handsome and the most desired, but they are with me”. Giusy adds: “Let them be beautiful but not stupid. Desirable and fascinating”. Through the value of their partner, the social E3 also acquires a vicarious value (“tell me who you hang out with and I’ll tell you who you are”), and climbs on the pedestal of their companion.

Generally, when an E3 is asked how he knows when he loves someone, he doesn't say, “Because I feel love.” He doesn’t know how to explain well what love is, to love. He says: “I like to watch them”, “I like what they do”, “because they love me”... These are explanations that do not evoke feelings. He may also feel cold and wonder if he really loves his partner.
summary: Объясняет, как социальный E3 выбирает партнера как символ статуса и использует его для подтверждения собственной ценности, испытывая трудности в осознании и выражении подлинных чувств любви.

title: Контакт с эмоциями: путь к внутренней правде
text:
When and how does social E3 take contact with emotion?

This character needs to look inward, without being aware of the approving look. Only by looking inward will he be able to recognize his own feelings, instead of acting out the emotion —usually positive— that he is supposed to feel in each circumstance. The difficult thing is, at first, to feel anything at all, because the version, in the emotional field, of the inner emptiness of the social E3 is coldness, the absence of affectivity.

Sometimes, the lack of emotionality is coupled with a lack of compassion towards the suffering of others. Haydée says that, in her classes, “I was very harsh in how I said things, and the students cried. And I thought they were idiots, what a beast, I didn't realize it, I wasn't capable of feeling anything in the face of the crying of a small child!”

When asked what is the worst that could happen if they express the emotions they contain, they reply: “It's a loss of control. You cannot own your life; others are the ones who decide for you...” And also:

“If I come into contact with grief I am left completely defenseless, I lose the tools to move. Weakness is the opposite of what I do all the time: I show that I am strong, that I can handle anything. If I let myself be in weakness, I feel very small and without physical strength for action. I lose energy and defense. It is literally as if the structure has cracked.”

(HAYDÉE)

“In this last year, when I meditate, I cry. Continually. I have convinced myself that it is a cry of letting go of the tension of control. I don't know if it has ortho meaning. I lose energy, I lose defenses...” (FRANCESCO)
summary: Описывает сложности социального E3 в доступе к собственным эмоциям из-за страха потери контроля, внутренней пустоты и отсутствия сострадания, а также первые шаги к эмоциональной честности через внутреннюю работу и плач как освобождение.

title: Внутренняя работа социального E3 и появление новых эмоций
text:
The crying and a deep defenseless sadness that arise in the inner work of the social E3 have to do, probably, with a self-pity for the child who was not seen, who had to act and make merits to be taken into account.

Within the range of possible emotions that begin to emerge, there are two things typical of E6 that begin to appear when the social E3 begins to get to know itself better and to deconstruct its apparent security. One of them is fear, a blind spot that he must deal with on his way to becoming aware. And for someone as self-assured as the social E3, there is another second aspect that is revealed: beginning to be uncertain and to doubt means loosening the idealized self-image and coming into contact with uncertainty: “I'm not sure of anything and I'm also scared.”
summary: This chunk describes the emotional emergence in social E3 during inner work, linking sadness and defenselessness to unresolved childhood neglect. It notes the appearance of fear and uncertainty—traits typical of E6—as the E3 begins to dismantle its façade of security and faces vulnerability.

title: Уязвимость, принятие и аутентичность в процессе роста E3
text:
When he goes through life triumphant and successful, he can receive admiration, envy, he can be used for his ability to work... but he doesn’t receive affection! When the social E3 shows weakness, he discovers that the others protect and love him, despite his flaws. Accepting the compassion of the other is for the social enneatype Three an act of humility that brings out one’s own emotions so long repressed under the image of a competent adult.

In safe and contained environments such as the SAT process, the mask falls off and social E3s can feel fearful, fragile, introverted, serious and, as contact with their most authentic truth progresses, increasingly relaxed and softened:

“When, in silence, I connect with myself,” says Haydée, “I go out calmer, I walk more slowly, I speak more slowly, I recover... I see more clearly what is not mine, what I have adopted. On the SAT people tell me: ‘You are much more human’.” For Francesco, “an E3 begins to develop if it ceases to be dependent on others, on work, on the demonstration of its capabilities. Freely choosing the commitments, the work to be dedicated to... Here it takes the real strength, to become authentic.”
summary: This section explains how social E3s, despite external success, lack genuine affection until they show weakness and receive compassion. In safe environments like SAT, their mask drops, allowing them to access fear, fragility, and eventually authenticity through self-connection and independence from external validation.

title: Сексуальность, вина и фантазии социального E3
text:
How sexuality moves through fantasy

As Francesco points out,

“E3 already feels guilty for existing. Beneath the guilt is a bigger void, if it doesn’t exist, relative to the parents’ expectations. You idealize what you could have been, and you know you’re not doing it, and you feel guilty. And sex is also linked to guilt. You feel like a whore deep down, but you repress it.”

The social E3 is eroticized by power and social flashiness. A person invested with attributes that qualify them as belonging to the elite (economic, social, intellectual) is more attractive than someone who simply loves. The measure of affection can be economic: I am worth so much, they love me so much.

The fantasy of a social E3 is to be admired. He knows he can’t trust his body as much as the Three sexual; effective strategy but with an expiration date. His happens, instead, by being admired for qualities such as brilliance, elegance, class, the world, glamour... He seduces with his attitude and with his symbolic and mental attributes and, more than desire, aspires to awaken admiration and respect. Not a primary sexual desire but mediated by the exquisiteness of the culture.

As the staging is calculated, the social E3 shines in other meetings, where he impresses the interlocutor – if it is a group, better –, but secretly fears being seen beyond the facade and revealing his inner emptiness. For this reason, his strategy is to play with the fantasies of the other, to let himself be seen under the studied and flattering lights of the theater, to later disappear and endure as an echo of fantasy. Be seen but not be touched. Fascinate many but commit to none. The thought that: “I am loved by the prestigious so-and-so therefore I am valuable...” This whole game is still an illusion. Pure theater.
summary: This chunk explores how social E3s experience sexuality through guilt and fantasy, linking it to parental expectations and self-worth. Their eroticism is tied to status and admiration rather than physical desire, relying on cultivated image and intellectual allure. Their strategy is to be admired from a distance, avoiding true intimacy while maintaining an illusion of value through external validation.

title: Поиск собственного желания без внешних зеркал
text: It is good for social E3s to ask themselves what their own desire is, without mirrors, without anyone’s gaze mediating them, without needing to arouse any desire (not even from a fantasized or imagined “other”). They may then find that they don’t know what they want, or they may find that they have turned away from their desire for fear of the consequences of expressing it.
summary: This final section encourages social E3s to disconnect from external validation and fantasized others to discover their authentic desires. It acknowledges that this introspection may reveal either a lack of self-knowledge or a history of suppressing desire due to fear of consequences.
